title.zh: 卷131 志一百六 兵二 绿营
title.en: Volume 131 Treatises 106: Military 2, Green Standard Army
title.raw: 卷131 志一百六 兵二 绿营

sentences.zh: 志一百六

translations.literal: Treatise 106
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 106

sentences.zh: 兵二

translations.literal: Military 2
translations.idiomatic: On Military Affairs, Part Two

sentences.zh: 綠營

translations.literal: Green Standard Army
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army

sentences.zh: 綠營規制，始自前明。

translations.literal: Green Standard Army regulations began from the Former Ming.
translations.idiomatic: The institutional regulations of the Green Standard Army originated under the previous Ming dynasty.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，天下已定，始建各省營制。

translations.literal: In the early Shunzhi period of the Qing, when the empire had been settled, provincial garrison systems were first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shunzhi reign, once the realm had been pacified, the Qing began establishing garrison systems in each province.

sentences.zh: 綠營之制，有馬兵、守兵、戰兵。

translations.literal: In the Green Standard Army system, there were cavalry soldiers, garrison soldiers, and combat soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army was organized into three categories: cavalry, garrison troops, and combat troops.

sentences.zh: 戰守皆步兵。

translations.literal: Both combat and garrison troops were all infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Both combat and garrison soldiers served as infantry.

sentences.zh: 額外外委皆馬兵。

translations.literal: Extra-quota and outside-deputy personnel were all cavalry soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Extra-strength personnel and outside deputies were all mounted troops.

sentences.zh: 綜天下制兵都六十六萬人，安徽最少，閩、廣以有水師故最多，甘肅次之。

translations.literal: Altogether the empire's established troops numbered 660,000; Anhui had the fewest; Fujian and Guangdong, because they had naval forces, had the most; Gansu was second.
translations.idiomatic: In all, the empire's authorized troop strength totaled 660,000 men. Anhui had the smallest contingent; Fujian and Guangdong, owing to their naval forces, had the largest; Gansu ranked second.

sentences.zh: 綠營隸禁旅者，惟京師五城巡捕營步兵。

translations.literal: Among Green Standard troops subordinate to the metropolitan Banner garrisons, only the infantry of the Five-City Patrol Battalions in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The only Green Standard troops placed under the metropolitan Banner garrisons were the infantry of the capital's Five-City Patrol Battalions.

sentences.zh: 將軍兼統綠營者惟四川。

translations.literal: Only in Sichuan did a regional general also command Green Standard troops.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan alone had a regional general who concurrently commanded Green Standard forces.

sentences.zh: 有屯兵者惟湖南、貴州。

translations.literal: Only Hunan and Guizhou had military colonists.
translations.idiomatic: Only Hunan and Guizhou maintained military-farming colonists.

sentences.zh: 其新疆之綠營屯防，始乾隆二十五年，由陝、甘陸續移往駐防。

translations.literal: As for the Green Standard garrison-colony defense in Xinjiang, it began in the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong, when troops were gradually transferred from Shaanxi and Gansu for garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard colonization and garrison duty in Xinjiang began in Qianlong 25 (1760), with troops gradually transferred from Shaanxi and Gansu for permanent stationing.

sentences.zh: 各省標兵規制，督撫得隨時疏定。

translations.literal: The regulations for provincial garrison troops, governors-general and governors could memorialize and fix at any time.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors-general and governors could petition at any time to determine the regulations governing garrison troops in their jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 綠營戰功，自康熙征三籓時，用旗、綠兵至四十萬，雲、貴多山地，綠營步兵居前，旗兵繼之，所向輒捷。

translations.literal: Green Standard military achievements: from the time of the Kangxi campaign against the Three Feudatories, Banner and Green Standard troops used reached 400,000; Yunnan and Guizhou were mostly mountainous; Green Standard infantry went forward, Banner troops followed, and wherever they went they were invariably victorious.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army's battlefield record began with the Kangxi campaign against the Three Feudatories, when as many as 400,000 Banner and Green Standard troops were deployed. In the mountainous terrain of Yunnan and Guizhou, Green Standard infantry led the advance with Banner troops following behind, and the combined force prevailed wherever it was sent.

sentences.zh: 其後平定準部、回疆、金川，咸有勛績。

translations.literal: Thereafter in pacifying the Dzungar tribes, the Muslim borderlands, and Jinchuan, they all had meritorious achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In later campaigns to subdue the Dzungars, pacify the Muslim frontier, and conquer Jinchuan, they likewise won distinguished honors.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十六年增兵，而川、楚教匪之役，英、法通商之役，兵力反遜於前。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong troops were increased, yet in the Sichuan-Hubei sectarian rebellion campaign and the British-French trade campaigns, military strength was actually inferior to before.
translations.idiomatic: Although troop strength was expanded in Qianlong 46 (1781), during the White Lotus rebellion in Sichuan and Hubei and the wars over trade with Britain and France, effective military power actually fell short of earlier levels.

sentences.zh: 迨粵寇起，廣西綠營額兵二萬三千，土兵一萬四千，遇敵輒靡。

translations.literal: When the Taiping rebels arose, Guangxi Green Standard quota troops numbered 23,000, local militia 14,000, and upon meeting the enemy they invariably collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebellion broke out, Guangxi's Green Standard force stood at 23,000 authorized troops and 14,000 local militia, yet they invariably broke and fled at the first contact with the enemy.

sentences.zh: 承平日久，暮氣乘之，自同治迄光緒，疊經裁汰，綠營之制，僅存而已。

translations.literal: Long peace bred stagnation; from Tongzhi to Guangxu, through repeated cuts and eliminations, the Green Standard system survived only in name.
translations.idiomatic: After decades of peace, decay set in. From the Tongzhi through the Guangxu reigns, successive rounds of retrenchment reduced the Green Standard Army to a hollow shell of its former self.

sentences.zh: 京師巡捕五營，設步軍統領一人，統左右翼總兵官以及十六門門千總，海淀、暢春園、樹村汛、靜宜園、樂善園設副將或守備各官不等，置兵共三千人。

translations.literal: The capital's five patrol battalions had one metropolitan infantry commander, who commanded the left and right wing regional commanders as well as the captains of the sixteen gates; at guard posts including Haidian, Changchun Garden, Shucun, Jingyi Garden, and Leshan Garden, deputy commanders or garrison commanders and other officers of varying rank were posted, with a total force of 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's five patrol battalions were headed by a single metropolitan infantry commander, who oversaw the left- and right-wing regional commanders, the captains stationed at the sixteen city gates, and the deputy commanders and garrison commanders posted at guard posts such as Haidian, Changchun Garden, Shucun, Jingyi Garden, and Leshan Garden, with a combined strength of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 京城內九門、外七門，每門設千總二，門甲十或二十，門軍四十人。

translations.literal: At the capital's nine inner gates and seven outer gates, each gate had two captains, ten or twenty gate sergeants, and forty gate soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: At each of the capital's nine inner gates and seven outer gates, two captains were posted, along with ten or twenty gate sergeants and forty gate soldiers.

sentences.zh: 左翼總兵統步軍營巡捕南、左二營各汛官，凡兵三千六百有奇。

translations.literal: The left-wing regional commander commanded the guard-post officers of the southern and left patrol battalions of the metropolitan infantry, totaling somewhat more than 3,600 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The left-wing regional commander oversaw the guard-post officers of the southern and left patrol battalions of the metropolitan infantry, with a total strength of somewhat more than 3,600 men.

sentences.zh: 右翼總兵統步軍營巡捕北、右二營各汛官，凡兵二千五百有奇。

translations.literal: The right-wing regional commander commanded the guard-post officers of the northern and right patrol battalions of the metropolitan infantry, totaling somewhat more than 2,500 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The right-wing regional commander oversaw the guard-post officers of the northern and right patrol battalions of the metropolitan infantry, with a total strength of somewhat more than 2,500 men.

sentences.zh: 各直省營制，順治元年，定直隸官兵經制，設直隸巡撫，標兵分左、右二營，游擊以下八人。

translations.literal: As for the garrison systems of the various provinces, in the first year of Shunzhi the regular establishment of Zhili officers and troops was fixed; a Zhili governor was appointed; garrison troops were divided into left and right battalions, with eight officers from brigade commander downward.
translations.idiomatic: Regarding provincial garrison systems: in Shunzhi 1 (1644), the regular establishment for Zhili's officers and troops was set. A Zhili governor was appointed, with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions and eight officers ranked from brigade commander down.

sentences.zh: 設宣府、真定、薊州、通州、天津、山海關六鎮總兵官及鎮標守備、游擊等，設紫荊關等七協副將及協標官兵，設拱極城等十七處參將，山永等營游擊，鞏華城等處守備、都司，分領各營兵。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at six garrisons—Xuanfu, Zhending, Jizhou, Tongzhou, Tianjin, and Shanhaiguan—with garrison commanders, brigade commanders, and others under their standards; seven brigade deputy commanders were established at places including Zijing Pass, with brigade garrison officers and troops; regimental vice commanders were established at seventeen posts including Gongji City; brigade commanders at camps such as Shanyong; garrison commanders and company commanders at places such as Gonghuacheng, each commanding their respective battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at six garrison towns—Xuanfu, Zhending, Jizhou, Tongzhou, Tianjin, and Shanhaiguan—each with garrison commanders, brigade commanders, and other subordinates under his standard. Seven brigade deputy commanders were established at posts including Zijing Pass, with their own brigade garrison forces. Regimental vice commanders were posted at seventeen locations including Gongji City; brigade commanders at camps such as Shanyong; and garrison commanders and company commanders at posts such as Gonghuacheng, each commanding their respective battalion troops.

sentences.zh: 定山東官兵經制，設河道總督，標兵分中、左、右三營，設副將或游擊以下將領八，兵凡三千，備河防護運。

translations.literal: The regular establishment of Shandong officers and troops was fixed; a Grand Canal governor-general was appointed; garrison troops were divided into center, left, and right battalions, with eight officers from deputy commander or brigade commander downward, totaling 3,000 troops, to guard the river and protect grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong's regular establishment was set with a Grand Canal governor-general in charge. Garrison troops were organized into center, left, and right battalions, with eight officers ranked from deputy commander or brigade commander down and a total strength of 3,000 men assigned to river defense and grain transport escort.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫標兵分左右二營，設游擊以下將領八，兵凡二千。

translations.literal: The Shandong governor's garrison troops were divided into left and right battalions, with eight officers from brigade commander downward, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong governor's garrison troops were split into left and right battalions, with eight officers from brigade commander down and a total strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設臨清、沂州二鎮總兵官及將領八，兵共二千四百有奇。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at two garrisons, Linqing and Yizhou, with eight subordinate officers and somewhat more than 2,400 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the two garrison towns of Linqing and Yizhou, each with eight subordinate officers and a combined strength of somewhat more than 2,400 men.

sentences.zh: 設德州、青州、武定三營參將或守備將領八或六，兵共二千二百有奇。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders or garrison commanders were established at three camps—Dezhou, Qingzhou, and Wuding—with eight or six officers and somewhat more than 2,200 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders or garrison commanders were posted at the three camps of Dezhou, Qingzhou, and Wuding, with eight or six officers respectively and a combined strength of somewhat more than 2,200 men.

sentences.zh: 設登州水師營守備，登州、萊州、臨清、濟南各營游擊或守備四，兵共一千二百有奇。

translations.literal: A naval garrison commander was established at the Dengzhou naval camp; four brigade commanders or garrison commanders were established at camps in Dengzhou, Laizhou, Linqing, and Jinan, with somewhat more than 1,200 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: A garrison commander was posted to the Dengzhou naval camp, and brigade commanders or garrison commanders to camps at Dengzhou, Laizhou, Linqing, and Jinan, with a combined strength of somewhat more than 1,200 men.

sentences.zh: 初，山東與直隸、河南共一總督，康熙元年，設山東提督，尋並裁去，以巡撫兼任。

translations.literal: Initially Shandong shared one governor-general with Zhili and Henan; in the first year of Kangxi a Shandong provincial military commander was established, but soon both posts were abolished, and the governor took concurrent charge.
translations.idiomatic: At first Shandong was governed jointly with Zhili and Henan under a single governor-general. In Kangxi 1 (1662) a Shandong provincial military commander was appointed, but both that post and the separate governorship were soon abolished, and the governor assumed concurrent military command.

sentences.zh: 山西、江南、陝西官兵經制，並於順治二年定之。

translations.literal: The regular establishments of Shanxi, Jiangnan, and Shaanxi officers and troops were all fixed in the second year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The regular establishments for the officers and troops of Shanxi, Jiangnan, and Shaanxi were all set in Shunzhi 2 (1645).

sentences.zh: 山西設宣大總督及巡撫，督標分中、左、右三營，撫標分左右營，各設將領八，兵凡二千。

translations.literal: In Shanxi a Xuanda governor-general and a governor were established; the governor-general's garrison troops were divided into center, left, and right battalions; the governor's garrison troops into left and right battalions; each had eight officers, with 2,000 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi received a Xuanda governor-general and a provincial governor. The governor-general's garrison troops were organized into center, left, and right battalions; the governor's into left and right battalions. Each had eight officers and a combined strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設太原、平陽二協副將及協標官兵。

translations.literal: Two brigade deputy commanders were established at Taiyuan and Pingyang, with brigade garrison officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Taiyuan and Pingyang, each with brigade garrison officers and troops under his command.

sentences.zh: 設汾州等營參將、游擊、守備，分領營兵。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were established at camps such as Fenzhou, each commanding battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were posted at camps such as Fenzhou to command their respective battalion forces.

sentences.zh: 十三年，裁宣大總督，康熙元年，設山西提督，迭裁迭復，雍正九年仍裁之，以巡撫兼任。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Xuanda governor-general was abolished; in the first year of Kangxi a Shanxi provincial military commander was established; the post was repeatedly abolished and restored; in the ninth year of Yongzheng it was abolished again, and the governor took concurrent charge.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 13 (1656) the Xuanda governor-general was abolished. A Shanxi provincial military commander was appointed in Kangxi 1 (1662), but the post was cut and restored repeatedly until Yongzheng 9 (1731), when it was abolished for good and the governor assumed concurrent military command.

sentences.zh: 江南設漕運總督，江蘇、鳳廬二巡撫，標兵及左右營如制，將領九或八人，兵共四千有奇，並設奇兵營、游兵營。

translations.literal: In Jiangnan a grain-transport governor-general was established, along with governors of Jiangsu and Fenglu; garrison troops and left and right battalions followed the standard pattern, with nine or eight officers and somewhat more than 4,000 troops in all, and special-force and mobile battalions were also established.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan received a grain-transport governor-general and governors for Jiangsu and Fenglu. Garrison troops were organized into left and right battalions according to standard practice, with nine or eight officers and a combined strength of somewhat more than 4,000 men, along with special-force and mobile battalions.

sentences.zh: 設江南漢兵提督，分中、左、右、前、後五營，分設將領八，兵凡四千。

translations.literal: A Jiangnan Han-troops provincial military commander was established, with five battalions—center, left, right, front, and rear—each with eight officers, totaling 4,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiangnan provincial military commander for Han troops was appointed, with garrison forces divided into center, left, right, front, and rear battalions, eight officers in each, and a total strength of 4,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設蘇州、鎮江、浦口、安慶、池太、東山、廣德八鎮總兵官，鎮標兵及將領。

translations.literal: Eight regional commanders were established at garrisons including Suzhou, Zhenjiang, Pukou, Anqing, Chitai, Dongshan, and Guangde, with garrison troops and subordinate officers.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at eight garrison towns—including Suzhou, Zhenjiang, Pukou, Anqing, Chitai, Dongshan, and Guangde—each with his own garrison troops and subordinate officers.

sentences.zh: 設狼山等七協副將，金山、常州各營參將、游擊、守備，分領營兵。

translations.literal: Seven brigade deputy commanders were established at places including Langshan; regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were established at camps in Jinshan and Changzhou, each commanding battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seven brigade deputy commanders were posted at posts including Langshan, and regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders at camps in Jinshan and Changzhou, each commanding his respective battalion forces.

sentences.zh: 國初設江南江西河南總督。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty a Jiangnan-Jiangxi-Henan governor-general was established.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding, a governor-general over Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Henan was appointed.

sentences.zh: 其後分合不常。

translations.literal: Thereafter its division and merger were not constant.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the jurisdiction was repeatedly split and recombined.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，定為兩江總督。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign it was fixed as the Two Jiangs governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi reign it was permanently established as the Two Jiangs governor-generalship.

sentences.zh: 又裁鳳廬巡撫歸併江蘇。

translations.literal: The Fenglu governor was also abolished and merged into Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: The Fenglu governorship was abolished and its jurisdiction merged into Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 設蘇松提督。

translations.literal: A Suzhou-Songjiang provincial military commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Suzhou-Songjiang provincial military commander was appointed.

sentences.zh: 尋定為江寧提督，增安徽提督，分轄營務。

translations.literal: Soon it was fixed as the Jiangning provincial military commander; an Anhui provincial military commander was added, and they divided garrison affairs between them.
translations.idiomatic: The post was soon fixed as the Jiangning provincial military commander, with an additional Anhui provincial military commander appointed to divide garrison duties between them.

sentences.zh: 又裁安徽提督，改江南水陸提督，統全省官兵。

translations.literal: The Anhui provincial military commander was abolished again, and the post was changed to a Jiangnan land-and-naval provincial military commander, commanding all provincial officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Anhui provincial military commander was abolished, the post was redesignated as Jiangnan land-and-naval provincial military commander, and the holder was given command over all provincial forces.

sentences.zh: 先是設操江巡撫，轄安慶等五府，滁、和等三州兵。

translations.literal: Previously a Caojiang governor had been established, commanding the troops of five prefectures including Anqing and three departments including Chuzhou and Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a Caojiang governor had been appointed with authority over the troops of five prefectures including Anqing and three sub-prefectures including Chuzhou and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 後改安徽巡撫，以鳳廬兵並屬之。

translations.literal: Later it was changed to the Anhui governor, and the Fenglu troops were also placed under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The post was later redesignated as Anhui governor, and the Fenglu garrison troops were placed under his command as well.

sentences.zh: 陝西初設川陝總督，並轄四川兵，標兵分五營。

translations.literal: Shaanxi initially had a Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, who also commanded Sichuan troops; garrison troops were divided into five battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi initially fell under a Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general who also commanded Sichuan's forces, with garrison troops organized into five battalions.

sentences.zh: 別設西安、延綏、甘肅、寧夏四巡撫，標兵各分左右營，將領略如諸省。

translations.literal: Separately governors were established at Xi'an, Yansui, Gansu, and Ningxia; garrison troops in each were divided into left and right battalions, with officers roughly as in other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were separately appointed for Xi'an, Yansui, Gansu, and Ningxia, each with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions and officer complements similar to those of other provinces.

sentences.zh: 設延綏、固原、臨鞏、鳳翔、漢羌、甘肅六鎮總兵官，鎮標兵亦分五營，將領如之，延綏又分設東西二協。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at six garrisons—Yansui, Guyuan, Lingzhou, Fengxiang, Hanzhong-Qiang, and Gansu; garrison troops under each were also divided into five battalions with officers to match; at Yansui east and west brigades were further established.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at six garrison towns—Yansui, Guyuan, Lingzhou, Fengxiang, Hanzhong-Qiang, and Gansu—each with garrison troops organized into five battalions and a matching officer complement. At Yansui, separate east and west brigades were also established.

sentences.zh: 設西安、慶陽等八處副將，宜君、階州等各營參將、游擊、都司及守備，分領營兵。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders were established at eight posts including Xi'an and Qingyang; regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, company commanders, and garrison commanders were established at camps including Yijun and Jiezhou, each commanding battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders were posted at eight locations including Xi'an and Qingyang, and regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, company commanders, and garrison commanders at camps including Yijun and Jiezhou, each commanding his respective battalion forces.

sentences.zh: 康熙時，迭改川陝總督，並轄山、陝、甘。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general was repeatedly changed, and came to command Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu together.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi reign the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-generalship was repeatedly reorganized until its holder commanded Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu jointly.

sentences.zh: 尋改川陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Soon it was changed to the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: The post was soon redesignated as Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，甘肅分設總督，以四川總督兼轄陝西兵，為川陝總督，復改陝甘總督。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign a separate Gansu governor-general was established; the Sichuan governor-general concurrently commanded Shaanxi troops as the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general; it was then changed again to the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign a separate Gansu governor-general was appointed. The Sichuan governor-general temporarily assumed command of Shaanxi's forces as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, before the post was again redesignated as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 國初設甘肅巡撫，其寧夏、延綏巡撫先後裁撤，寧夏歸甘肅，延綏歸陝西。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty a Gansu governor was established; the Ningxia and Yansui governors were abolished in succession; Ningxia was returned to Gansu, Yansui to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding a Gansu governor was appointed. The Ningxia and Yansui governorships were abolished in turn, with Ningxia reverting to Gansu and Yansui to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 後又裁甘肅巡撫，陝甘總督兼統撫標兵。

translations.literal: Later the Gansu governor was abolished again, and the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general concurrently commanded the governor's garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Gansu governorship was later abolished, and the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general assumed concurrent command of the governor's garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 甘州置甘肅總兵官，尋改設甘肅提督。

translations.literal: A Gansu regional commander was posted at Ganzhou; soon the post was changed to a Gansu provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: A regional commander was posted at Ganzhou and soon promoted to Gansu provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 初設陝西漢兵提督及寧夏提督，分五營，皆設將領八，兵凡四千人。

translations.literal: Initially a Shaanxi Han-troops provincial military commander and a Ningxia provincial military commander were established, each with five battalions, eight officers in each, and 4,000 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: At first provincial military commanders for Shaanxi Han troops and for Ningxia were appointed, each with five battalions, eight officers per battalion, and a total strength of 4,000 men.

sentences.zh: 後改西安提督，又移駐固原，改固原提督雲。

translations.literal: Later it was changed to the Xi'an provincial military commander; then headquarters were moved to Guyuan, and the post was changed to the Guyuan provincial military commander [雲 is a scribal corruption].
translations.idiomatic: The post was later redesignated as Xi'an provincial military commander, then relocated to Guyuan and established as the Guyuan provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，定河南、江西、湖廣官兵經制。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi the regular establishments of Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang officers and troops were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 (1646), the regular establishments for the officers and troops of Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang were set.

sentences.zh: 河南設巡撫，標兵分左右營，將領八，兵二千，制同上。

translations.literal: In Henan a governor was established; garrison troops were divided into left and right battalions, with eight officers and 2,000 troops, following the same pattern as above.
translations.idiomatic: Henan received a provincial governor, with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions, eight officers, and 2,000 men, following the same pattern described above.

sentences.zh: 設河南提督，標兵分中、左、右三營，設將領分統。

translations.literal: A Henan provincial military commander was established; garrison troops were divided into center, left, and right battalions, with officers appointed to command each.
translations.idiomatic: A Henan provincial military commander was appointed, with garrison troops organized into center, left, and right battalions under separate commanding officers.

sentences.zh: 設河北、南陽、開歸三鎮總兵官，標兵各分左右營，將領兵數如撫標制。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at three garrisons—Hebei, Nanyang, and Kaigu—each with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions, with officers and troop numbers as under the governor's standard.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the three garrison towns of Hebei, Nanyang, and Kaigu, each with garrison troops split into left and right battalions and officer complements matching the governor's garrison standard.

sentences.zh: 設開封副將、守備以下將領七，兵一千人，河南衛輝、汝寧、歸德各營各參將等，兵各一千。

translations.literal: A Kaifeng deputy commander was established with seven officers from garrison commander downward and 1,000 troops; at camps in Henan's Weihui, Runing, and Guide, regimental vice commanders and others were established, each with 1,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Kaifeng deputy commander was posted with seven subordinate officers from garrison commander down and 1,000 men. At camps in Weihui, Runing, and Guide, regimental vice commanders and other officers were appointed, each commanding 1,000 troops.

sentences.zh: 設磁州營都司，兵五百人，後屬直隸嵩縣等二營守備，兵三百或二百。

translations.literal: A company commander was established at the Cizhou camp with 500 troops; later garrison commanders were established at two camps including Songxian under Zhili, with 300 or 200 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A company commander was posted at the Cizhou camp with 500 men. Later garrison commanders were assigned to two camps including Songxian under Zhili, with strengths of 300 or 200 men respectively.

sentences.zh: 先是河南與直隸、山東共一總督，兼轄河南官兵。

translations.literal: Previously Henan shared one governor-general with Zhili and Shandong, who also commanded Henan officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Henan was governed jointly with Zhili and Shandong under a single governor-general who also commanded Henan's forces.

sentences.zh: 其後或專設河南總督，或裁改之。

translations.literal: Thereafter either a separate Henan governor-general was established, or the post was abolished and changed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter a separate Henan governor-general was sometimes appointed and sometimes abolished or reorganized.

sentences.zh: 至雍正十三年，仍為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: By the thirteenth year of Yongzheng it remained the Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: By Yongzheng 13 (1735) the post had reverted to a Henan provincial governor.

sentences.zh: 江西初設巡撫及南贛巡撫，標兵分左右營，設將領五人，兵凡千五百人。

translations.literal: In Jiangxi a governor and a Nangan governor were initially established; garrison troops were divided into left and right battalions, with five officers and 1,500 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi initially received a provincial governor and a separate Nangan governor, with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions, five officers, and a total strength of 1,500 men.

sentences.zh: 設江西提督，標兵分五營，營設將領八，兵凡五千人。

translations.literal: A Jiangxi provincial military commander was established; garrison troops were divided into five battalions, each with eight officers, totaling 5,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiangxi provincial military commander was appointed, with garrison troops organized into five battalions of eight officers each and a total strength of 5,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設南贛、九江二鎮總兵官，標兵分五營，各設游擊以下將領官，兵如提標之數。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at two garrisons, Nangan and Jiujiang; garrison troops were divided into five battalions, each with officers from brigade commander downward, with troop numbers matching the provincial commander's standard.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the two garrison towns of Nangan and Jiujiang, each with garrison troops organized into five battalions, officers from brigade commander down, and troop strengths matching the provincial commander's standard.

sentences.zh: 設袁州等四協副將，分左右營，將領各八，兵凡二千人。

translations.literal: Four brigade deputy commanders were established at places including Yuanzhou, with left and right battalions, eight officers in each, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Four brigade deputy commanders were posted at posts including Yuanzhou, each with left and right battalions, eight officers per side, and a combined strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設廣德各營參將，撫州各水師營守備，兵六百人，南康等營守備兵三百人。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders were established at various Guangde camps; naval garrison commanders were established at various Fuzhou naval camps with 600 troops; garrison commanders at camps including Nankang had 300 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders were posted to various Guangde camps, naval garrison commanders to Fuzhou naval camps with 600 men, and garrison commanders to camps including Nankang with 300 men.

sentences.zh: 康熙初年，裁南贛巡撫，以標兵屬江西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi reign the Nangan governor was abolished, and the garrison troops were placed under the Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kangxi reign the Nangan governorship was abolished and its garrison troops transferred to the Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 七年，裁提督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the provincial military commander was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 (1668) the provincial military commander was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十三年，復設。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13 (1674) the post was restored.

sentences.zh: 嗣增設撫建提督，旋裁之，並裁江西提督，以巡撫兼任。

translations.literal: Later a Fuzhou-Jian provincial military commander was added, but soon abolished; the Jiangxi provincial military commander was also abolished, and the governor took concurrent charge.
translations.idiomatic: A Fuzhou-Jian provincial military commander was later added but soon abolished. The Jiangxi provincial military commander was abolished as well, and the governor assumed concurrent military command.

sentences.zh: 湖廣設總督，標兵分中、左、右營，將領各八，兵凡三千人。

translations.literal: In Huguang a governor-general was established; garrison troops were divided into center, left, and right battalions, each with eight officers, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang received a governor-general, with garrison troops organized into center, left, and right battalions of eight officers each and a total strength of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設湖北巡撫、鄖陽巡撫、偏沅巡撫，撫標兵分左右營，將領官兵如江西撫標例。

translations.literal: Governors were established for Hubei, Yunyang, and Pianyuan; governors' garrison troops were divided into left and right battalions, with officers and troops following the Jiangxi governor's garrison pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were appointed for Hubei, Yunyang, and Pianyuan, each with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions and officer complements matching the Jiangxi governor's garrison standard.

sentences.zh: 設湖廣提督，標兵分五營，將領官兵如江西提標例。

translations.literal: A Huguang provincial military commander was established; garrison troops were divided into five battalions, with officers and troops following the Jiangxi provincial commander's garrison pattern.
translations.idiomatic: A Huguang provincial military commander was appointed, with garrison troops organized into five battalions and officer complements matching the Jiangxi provincial commander's standard.

sentences.zh: 設荊州、鄖陽、長沙三鎮總兵官，辰州協副將，標兵各分中、左、右營，各設將領八，兵凡三千人。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at three garrisons—Jingzhou, Yunyang, and Changsha—and a brigade deputy commander at Chenzhou; garrison troops in each were divided into center, left, and right battalions, each with eight officers, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the three garrison towns of Jingzhou, Yunyang, and Changsha, with a brigade deputy commander at Chenzhou. Each had garrison troops organized into center, left, and right battalions of eight officers apiece and a combined strength of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設黃州、承天、常德三協副將，協標兵各設將領七，兵凡千二百人。

translations.literal: Three brigade deputy commanders were established at Huangzhou, Chengtian, and Changde; brigade garrison troops in each had seven officers, totaling 1,200 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Huangzhou, Chengtian, and Changde, each with seven officers under his brigade standard and a combined strength of 1,200 men.

sentences.zh: 承天協後改安陸營。

translations.literal: The Chengtian brigade was later changed to the Anlu camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengtian brigade was later redesignated as the Anlu camp.

sentences.zh: 設漢陽等營參將將領各四，兵六百人。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders were established at camps including Hanyang, each with four officers and 600 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders were posted to camps including Hanyang, each with four subordinate officers and 600 men.

sentences.zh: 夷陵等營游擊各設將領三，兵四百人。

translations.literal: Brigade commanders were established at camps including Yiling, each with three officers and 400 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade commanders were posted to camps including Yiling, each with three subordinate officers and 400 men.

sentences.zh: 設三江口等營守備、把總，兵各二百人。

translations.literal: Garrison commanders and platoon leaders were established at camps including Sanjiangkou, each with 200 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commanders and platoon leaders were posted to camps including Sanjiangkou, each commanding 200 men.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，並湖廣總督為川湖總督。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi reign the Huguang governor-general was merged into the Sichuan-Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kangxi reign the Huguang governor-generalship was merged into a combined Sichuan-Huguang governor-generalship.

sentences.zh: 其後四川總督不轄湖廣，復設湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Thereafter when the Sichuan governor-general no longer commanded Huguang, the Huguang governor-general was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sichuan governor-general ceased to oversee Huguang, a separate Huguang governor-general was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 裁鄖陽巡撫，以湖北巡撫統轄標兵。

translations.literal: The Yunyang governor was abolished, and the Hubei governor took unified command of the garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunyang governorship was abolished, and the Hubei governor assumed unified command of the garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，定四川官兵經制。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi the regular establishment of Sichuan officers and troops was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 (1647), the regular establishment for Sichuan's officers and troops was set.

sentences.zh: 設四川巡撫，標兵分左右營，各設將領八，兵凡千三百人。

translations.literal: A Sichuan governor was established; garrison troops were divided into left and right battalions, each with eight officers, totaling 1,300 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Sichuan governor was appointed, with garrison troops divided into left and right battalions of eight officers each and a total strength of 1,300 men.

sentences.zh: 設建昌、保寧、永寧、夔州四鎮總兵官，鎮標分三營，設將領八，兵凡二千人。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at four garrisons—Jianchang, Baoning, Yongning, and Kuizhou; garrison troops under each were divided into three battalions, with eight officers and 2,000 troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the four garrison towns of Jianchang, Baoning, Yongning, and Kuizhou, each with garrison troops organized into three battalions, eight officers, and a combined strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設松潘、成都、重慶三協副將，協標兵分二營，設游擊以下將領官兵。

translations.literal: Three brigade deputy commanders were established at Songpan, Chengdu, and Chongqing; brigade garrison troops were divided into two battalions, with officers from brigade commander downward.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Songpan, Chengdu, and Chongqing, each with brigade garrison troops organized into two battalions and officers from brigade commander down.

sentences.zh: 設威茂等各營參將、游擊、守備，分領營兵。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were established at various camps including Weimao, each commanding battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were posted to camps including Weimao to command their respective battalion forces.

sentences.zh: 四川初僅設巡撫，駐成都府。

translations.literal: Sichuan initially had only a governor, stationed at Chengdu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan initially had only a provincial governor, based at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 川陝總督駐陝西，兼轄四川十四年。

translations.literal: The Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general was stationed in Shaanxi and concurrently commanded Sichuan for fourteen years.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general was based in Shaanxi and exercised authority over Sichuan for fourteen years.

sentences.zh: 嗣設四川總督，駐重慶府。

translations.literal: Later a Sichuan governor-general was established, stationed at Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A separate Sichuan governor-general was later appointed, based at Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 其間或並為川湖總督，駐荊州九年，移駐重慶十九年。

translations.literal: In the interim it was sometimes merged as the Sichuan-Huguang governor-general, stationed at Jingzhou for nine years and then moved to Chongqing for nineteen years.
translations.idiomatic: In the interim the post was sometimes combined as Sichuan-Huguang governor-general, based at Jingzhou for nine years before relocating to Chongqing for nineteen years.

sentences.zh: 或云川陝甘，或云川陝，遷改靡常。

translations.literal: Sometimes it was called Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu, sometimes Sichuan-Shaanxi; transfers and changes were inconstant.
translations.idiomatic: At various times the jurisdiction was styled Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu or simply Sichuan-Shaanxi, with transfers and reorganizations changing constantly.

sentences.zh: 至乾隆間，定為四川總督。

translations.literal: By the Qianlong period it was fixed as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the post was finally fixed as governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，定浙江官兵經制。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi the regular establishment of Zhejiang officers and troops was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 5 (1648), the regular military establishment for Zhejiang was set.

sentences.zh: 設總督，標兵分三營，設副將或游擊將領各八，兵共三千。

translations.literal: A governor-general was established; garrison troops were divided into three battalions, with deputy commanders or brigade commanders and eight officers each, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A governor-general was appointed, with garrison troops organized into three battalions under deputy commanders or brigade commanders, eight officers each, for a total strength of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設浙江巡撫，標兵二營，將領各八，兵共二千。

translations.literal: A Zhejiang governor was established; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers each, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhejiang provincial governor was appointed, with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers each, and a combined strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 浙江提督標兵三營，營設將領八，兵共三千。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang provincial military commander's garrison troops were three battalions, each battalion with eight officers, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang provincial military commander had three battalions of garrison troops, each with eight officers, for a total of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設定海、衢州二鎮總兵官，標兵皆三營，營設將領八，共兵各三千。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at two garrison towns—Dinghai and Quzhou; garrison troops were all three battalions each, each battalion with eight officers, each totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the garrison towns of Dinghai and Quzhou, each with three battalions of garrison troops, eight officers per battalion, and a strength of 3,000 men apiece.

sentences.zh: 錢塘水師二營，台州水師三營，營設將領八，共兵各三千。

translations.literal: The Qiantang naval force had two battalions, the Taizhou naval force three battalions; each battalion had eight officers, each force totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiantang naval detachment comprised two battalions and the Taizhou naval detachment three, each with eight officers per battalion and a total strength of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 衢州設水師左右路總兵官，標兵三營，游擊以下將領分統營兵。

translations.literal: At Quzhou, left- and right-route naval regional commanders were established; garrison troops numbered three battalions, with officers from brigade commander downward separately commanding battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: At Quzhou, left- and right-route naval regional commanders were appointed, with three battalions of garrison troops commanded by officers from brigade commander down.

sentences.zh: 設衢州、湖州、嘉興等七協副將，標兵皆三營，營皆設將領八，每協共兵二千五、六百。

translations.literal: Seven brigade deputy commanders were established at Quzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, and elsewhere; garrison troops were all three battalions each, each battalion with eight officers, each brigade totaling 2,500–2,600 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Quzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, and four other locations—seven in all—each with three battalions of garrison troops, eight officers per battalion, and a brigade strength of roughly 2,500 to 2,600 men.

sentences.zh: 設金華、嚴州、處州三協副將，標兵二營，將領各八，共兵皆千六百。

translations.literal: Three brigade deputy commanders were established at Jinhua, Yanzhou, and Chuzhou; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers each, each totaling 1,600 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Jinhua, Yanzhou, and Chuzhou, each with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers each, and a combined strength of 1,600 men.

sentences.zh: 設吉安等各營守備、參將，分統營兵。

translations.literal: Garrison commanders and regimental vice commanders were established at various camps including Ji'an, each separately commanding battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commanders and regimental vice commanders were posted to camps including Ji'an to command their respective battalion forces.

sentences.zh: 先是設浙江總督，其後改稱閩浙，兼轄福建，裁改不常。

translations.literal: Previously a Zhejiang governor-general was established; afterward it was renamed Min-Zhe, concurrently governing Fujian; abolitions and changes were inconstant.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhejiang governor-general was initially appointed, later retitled Min-Zhe to govern Fujian as well, with frequent abolitions and reorganizations.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，定為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng period it was fixed as Min-Zhe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign the post was finally fixed as governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 順治七年，定福建官兵經制。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shunzhi the regular establishment of Fujian officers and troops was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 7 (1650), the regular military establishment for Fujian was set.

sentences.zh: 設福建巡撫，標兵二營，將領八，兵凡二千。

translations.literal: A Fujian governor was established; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Fujian provincial governor was appointed, with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and a total strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設福建水陸提督，標兵三營，營設將領八，兵凡三千。

translations.literal: A Fujian land-and-naval provincial military commander was established; garrison troops numbered three battalions, each battalion with eight officers, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Fujian land-and-naval provincial military commander was appointed, with three battalions of garrison troops, eight officers per battalion, and a total of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設汀州、泉州、銅山三鎮總兵官，及援剿總兵官、中路總兵官，標兵各二營，各設將領八，兵二千。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at three garrison towns—Tingzhou, Quanzhou, and Tongshan—as well as relief-suppression and middle-route regional commanders; garrison troops each numbered two battalions, each with eight officers, 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at Tingzhou, Quanzhou, and Tongshan, along with relief-suppression and middle-route regional commanders, each with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設福州、漳州、建寧三協副將，標兵三營，各設將領八，兵凡三千。

translations.literal: Three brigade deputy commanders were established at Fuzhou, Zhangzhou, and Jianning; garrison troops numbered three battalions, each with eight officers, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Fuzhou, Zhangzhou, and Jianning, each with three battalions of garrison troops, eight officers each, and a strength of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設福州水師，及汀州、興化、邵武、延平、閩安、同安七協副將標兵，各設將領八，兵凡二千。

translations.literal: A Fuzhou naval force was established, along with brigade garrison troops under seven brigade deputy commanders at Tingzhou, Xinghua, Shaowu, Yanping, Min'an, and Tong'an; each with eight officers, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Fuzhou naval detachment was established, along with brigade garrison troops under brigade deputy commanders at Tingzhou, Xinghua, Shaowu, Yanping, Min'an, and Tong'an—seven in all—each with eight officers and a strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設福寧協副將二營，將領七，兵凡千八百人。

translations.literal: The Funing brigade deputy commander had two battalions, seven officers, totaling 1,800 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Funing brigade deputy commander commanded two battalions with seven officers and a total strength of 1,800 men.

sentences.zh: 設泉州等營參將、長樂等營游擊，將領各八，共兵各一千。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders were established at camps including Quanzhou, and brigade commanders at camps including Changle; eight officers each, each totaling 1,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders were posted to camps including Quanzhou and brigade commanders to camps including Changle, each with eight officers and a strength of 1,000 men.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，定兩廣官兵經制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi the regular establishment of the Two Guangs officers and troops was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 (1651), the regular military establishment for Guangdong and Guangxi was set.

sentences.zh: 廣東設巡撫，標兵二營，將領八，兵凡二千。

translations.literal: In Guangdong a governor was established; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong received a provincial governor with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設廣東提督，標兵五營，將領八，兵凡五千。

translations.literal: A Guangdong provincial military commander was established; garrison troops numbered five battalions, eight officers, totaling 5,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Guangdong provincial military commander was appointed, with five battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and a total strength of 5,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設廣東水師總兵官，標兵六千，分左右二協，中、左、右三營。

translations.literal: A Guangdong naval regional commander was established; garrison troops numbered 6,000, divided into left and right brigades and center, left, and right three battalions.
translations.idiomatic: A Guangdong naval regional commander was appointed commanding 6,000 garrison troops, organized into left and right brigades and center, left, and right battalions.

sentences.zh: 二協設副將，復分二營，設將領八，兵一千五百。

translations.literal: The two brigades had deputy commanders, each further divided into two battalions, with eight officers and 1,500 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the two brigades had a deputy commander and was subdivided into two battalions with eight officers and 1,500 men.

sentences.zh: 三營水師，各設將領八，兵各一千。

translations.literal: The three naval battalions each had eight officers and 1,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the three naval battalions had eight officers and a strength of 1,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設肇慶、潮州、瓊州三鎮總兵官，標兵二營，將領八，兵凡二千。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at three garrison towns—Zhaoqing, Chaozhou, and Qiongzhou; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers, totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the garrison towns of Zhaoqing, Chaozhou, and Qiongzhou, each with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設韶州、惠州、高州、南雄四協副將，協標兵皆二營，將領各八，共兵各二千。

translations.literal: Four brigade deputy commanders were established at Shaozhou, Huizhou, Gaozhou, and Nanxiong; brigade garrison troops were all two battalions each, eight officers each, each totaling 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy commanders were posted at Shaozhou, Huizhou, Gaozhou, and Nanxiong, each with two battalions of brigade garrison troops, eight officers each, and a strength of 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 惟南雄為一千六百。

translations.literal: Only Nanxiong had 1,600.
translations.idiomatic: Only Nanxiong had a strength of 1,600 men.

sentences.zh: 設肇慶、高州水師及吳川等營參將，柘林鎮各營游擊，將領各七，共兵各一千。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders were established for the Zhaoqing and Gaozhou naval forces and at camps including Wuchuan, and brigade commanders at various Zhelin garrison camps; seven officers each, each totaling 1,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders were posted to the Zhaoqing and Gaozhou naval detachments and camps including Wuchuan, and brigade commanders to various Zhelin garrison camps, each with seven officers and a strength of 1,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設東莞、始興等州縣守備以下將領，兵二百至五百有差。

translations.literal: Officers from garrison commander downward were established in prefectures and counties including Dongguan and Shixing, with troops ranging from 200 to 500.
translations.idiomatic: Officers from garrison commander down were posted in prefectures and counties including Dongguan and Shixing, with troop strengths ranging from 200 to 500.

sentences.zh: 廣西設巡撫，標兵二營，將領八，兵凡千五百。

translations.literal: In Guangxi a governor was established; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers, totaling 1,500 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi received a provincial governor with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and 1,500 men.

sentences.zh: 廣西提督標兵分五營，將領八，兵凡四千有奇。

translations.literal: The Guangxi provincial military commander's garrison troops were divided into five battalions, eight officers, totaling slightly more than 4,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi provincial military commander's garrison troops were organized into five battalions with eight officers and a total strength of slightly over 4,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設左右翼總兵官，並桂林暨南寧城守營。

translations.literal: Left- and right-wing regional commanders were established, along with garrison camps at Guilin and Nanning.
translations.idiomatic: Left- and right-wing regional commanders were appointed, along with city-garrison camps at Guilin and Nanning.

sentences.zh: 九年，增設潯梧、柳慶、思南三協副將以下將領，兵各千二百；

translations.literal: In the ninth year, brigade deputy commanders and officers below were additionally established at Xunwu, Liuqing, and Sinan, each with 1,200 troops;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, brigade deputy commanders and subordinate officers were added at Xunwu, Liuqing, and Sinan, each with 1,200 men;

sentences.zh: 鬱林、新太、河池三營參將以下將領，兵各六百；

translations.literal: regimental vice commanders and officers below at three camps—Yulin, Xintai, and Hechi—each with 600 troops;
translations.idiomatic: regimental vice commanders and subordinate officers at the camps of Yulin, Xintai, and Hechi, each with 600 men;

sentences.zh: 永寧、昭平二營參將以下將領，兵各四百；

translations.literal: regimental vice commanders and officers below at two camps—Yongning and Zhaoping—each with 400 troops;
translations.idiomatic: regimental vice commanders and subordinate officers at the camps of Yongning and Zhaoping, each with 400 men;

sentences.zh: 上思、三里二營守備以下將領，兵各二百；

translations.literal: garrison commanders and officers below at two camps—Shangsi and Sanli—each with 200 troops;
translations.idiomatic: garrison commanders and subordinate officers at the camps of Shangsi and Sanli, each with 200 men;

sentences.zh: 賀縣營守備，兵百人。

translations.literal: The Hexian camp garrison commander had 100 troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexian camp garrison commander commanded 100 men.

sentences.zh: 十年，定兩廣總督標兵分五營，中營設將領八，左、右、前、後營共將領八，兵凡五千。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Two Guangs governor-general's garrison troops were fixed as five battalions; the center battalion had eight officers, the left, right, front, and rear battalions together had eight officers, totaling 5,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the Two Guangs governor-general's garrison troops were organized into five battalions—the center battalion with eight officers and the left, right, front, and rear battalions sharing eight officers among them—for a total strength of 5,000 men.

sentences.zh: 國初置兩廣總督，康熙二年，專轄廣東，四年，兼轄兩廣，雍正元年，復專轄廣東，十三年，仍兼轄兩廣。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty a Two Guangs governor-general was established; in the second year of Kangxi he governed Guangdong alone; in the fourth year he governed both Guangdongs; in the first year of Yongzheng he again governed Guangdong alone; in the thirteenth year he still governed both Guangdongs.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding a Two Guangs governor-general was appointed; in Kangxi 2 (1663) the post governed Guangdong alone; in Kangxi 4 (1665) it again covered both provinces; in Yongzheng 1 (1723) it reverted to Guangdong alone; and in Yongzheng 13 (1735) it once more governed both Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，定雲、貴官兵經制。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the regular establishment of Yunnan and Guizhou officers and troops was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659), the regular military establishment for Yunnan and Guizhou was set.

sentences.zh: 設雲貴總督，標兵分中、左、右、前四營，中營設將領八，餘三營將領八，兵凡四千。

translations.literal: A Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general was established; garrison troops were divided into center, left, right, and front four battalions; the center battalion had eight officers, the remaining three battalions had eight officers, totaling 4,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general was appointed, with garrison troops organized into center, left, right, and front battalions—the center battalion with eight officers and the other three sharing eight officers among them—for a total strength of 4,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設雲南巡撫，標兵二營，將領八，兵一千五百。

translations.literal: A Yunnan governor was established; garrison troops numbered two battalions, eight officers, 1,500 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A Yunnan provincial governor was appointed, with two battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and 1,500 men.

sentences.zh: 先一年，貴州設巡撫，營制亦同。

translations.literal: One year earlier, Guizhou had established a governor, with the same camp organization.
translations.idiomatic: One year earlier, Guizhou had received a provincial governor under the same camp organization.

sentences.zh: 及是設貴州提督，標兵分左、右、前、後四營，左營設將領八，餘三營將領八，兵凡三千。

translations.literal: At this time a Guizhou provincial military commander was established; garrison troops were divided into left, right, front, and rear four battalions; the left battalion had eight officers, the remaining three battalions had eight officers, totaling 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: At this point a Guizhou provincial military commander was appointed, with garrison troops organized into left, right, front, and rear battalions—the left battalion with eight officers and the other three sharing eight officers among them—for a total of 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設大定、黔西、鎮遠、威寧四鎮總兵官，標兵三營，將領八，兵各二千有奇。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were established at four garrison towns—Dading, Qianxi, Zhenyuan, and Weining; garrison troops numbered three battalions, eight officers, each totaling slightly more than 2,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were posted at the garrison towns of Dading, Qianxi, Zhenyuan, and Weining, each with three battalions of garrison troops, eight officers, and a strength of slightly over 2,000 men.

sentences.zh: 設貴陽城守協及平遠、定廣、銅仁、平越、安南五協副將，標兵二營，游擊以下將領。

translations.literal: The Guiyang city-garrison brigade and five brigade deputy commanders at Pingyuan, Dingguang, Tongren, Pingyue, and Annan were established; garrison troops numbered two battalions, with officers from brigade commander downward.
translations.idiomatic: A Guiyang city-garrison brigade and brigade deputy commanders at Pingyuan, Dingguang, Tongren, Pingyue, and Annan were established, each with two battalions of garrison troops and officers from brigade commander down.

sentences.zh: 設思南營等處參將、游擊、守備，分統官兵。

translations.literal: Regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were established at Sinan camp and elsewhere, separately commanding officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental vice commanders, brigade commanders, and garrison commanders were posted to Sinan camp and other locations to command their respective forces.

sentences.zh: 國初雲貴總督，兩省互駐。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general alternated residence between the two provinces.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general alternated his base between the two provinces.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，分置兩省總督，自後或改或並。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, separate governor-generals were established for the two provinces; thereafter there were alternately changes and mergers.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662), separate governor-generals were appointed for each province; thereafter the arrangement was repeatedly changed or merged.

sentences.zh: 迨乾隆中，仍定為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: By the Qianlong period it was again fixed as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the post was once again fixed as governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 此直省綠營初制也。

translations.literal: This was the initial system of the provincial Green Standard Army.
translations.idiomatic: This was the original regular establishment of the provincial Green Standard Army.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，靖逆將軍富寧安於哈密置大小卡路八，西安總兵潘之善於沙州西南諸隘設哨探、置台站防夷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, Pacification General Funing'an established eight large and small card posts at Hami, and Xi'an regional commander Pan Zhishan set scouts and relay stations at passes southwest of Shazhou to guard against barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 (1726), Pacification General Funing'an established eight large and small card posts at Hami, while Xi'an regional commander Pan Zhishan posted scouts and relay stations at passes southwest of Shazhou to guard against frontier incursions.

sentences.zh: 五年，以浙江綠營積弱，選山、陝、甘兵壯健者移駐之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because the Zhejiang Green Standard Army had long been weak, sturdy troops from Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu were selected and transferred to garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, finding the Zhejiang Green Standard Army chronically weak, the court selected sturdy troops from Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu and transferred them to garrison the province.

sentences.zh: 十年，以苗疆遼闊，貴州改設總兵、游擊，統轄丹江、台拱等營，及銅仁、鎮遠、石阡各協，並新設上江、下江諸營協，隸古州，以鎮攝之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because the Miao frontier was vast, Guizhou reorganized regional commanders and brigade commanders to command camps including Danjiang and Taigong, brigades at Tongren, Zhenyuan, and Shiqian, and newly established upper- and lower-river camps and brigades, all subordinate to Guzhou, to maintain control.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, given the vast Miao frontier, Guizhou reorganized regional commanders and brigade commanders to oversee camps including Danjiang and Taigong, brigades at Tongren, Zhenyuan, and Shiqian, and newly established upper- and lower-river camps and brigades subordinate to Guzhou for frontier control.

sentences.zh: 十一年，諭各總兵官巡察營伍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict ordered all regional commanders to inspect their camps and troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, an edict directed all regional commanders to inspect their camps and troops.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五年，用湖廣總督那蘇圖言，裁虛設戰船，除私立提塘，及字識占冒口糧之弊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qianlong, following the proposal of Huguang governor-general Nasutu, fictitious warships were abolished, private courier stations were eliminated, and abuses of nominal rolls and misappropriated rations were removed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 5 (1740), acting on Huguang governor-general Nasutu's proposal, the court abolished fictitious warships, eliminated private courier stations, and rooted out abuses involving padded rolls and misappropriated rations.

sentences.zh: 十六年，定哈密駐防兵制，於安、甘、涼、肅四提、鎮營分遣將弁廿餘，兵二千往駐。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the garrison troop system at Hami was fixed; more than twenty officers were dispatched from the four provincial military commanders' and garrison towns' camps of Anxi, Gansu, Liangzhou, and Suzhou, with 2,000 troops sent to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, the garrison system at Hami was fixed, with more than twenty officers dispatched from the camps of the Anxi, Gansu, Liangzhou, and Suzhou provincial military commanders and garrison towns, and 2,000 troops sent to garrison the post.

sentences.zh: 二年一受代，四月、八月迭更半數，新舊相間，以資教練。

translations.literal: Relief came every two years; in the fourth and eighth months half the force rotated in succession, new and old alternating, to facilitate training.
translations.idiomatic: Relief occurred every two years, with half the force rotating in the fourth and eighth months, new and old troops alternating to maintain training.

sentences.zh: 回營時，鎮臣核其勤惰，分別擢用之。

translations.literal: Upon returning to camp, the garrison commander assessed diligence and slackness and promoted or employed men accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Upon returning to their home camps, garrison commanders assessed each man's diligence or slackness and promoted or employed them accordingly.

sentences.zh: 十八年，陝甘總督尹繼善疏陳西陲防務，宜慎選安西將材，多備槍彈，預蓄資糧，築城垣，擇畜牧，允行。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Yin Jishan memorialized on western frontier defense, advising careful selection of capable officers for Anxi, ample stockpiles of firearms and ammunition, advance accumulation of supplies, construction of walls, and choice of pasturelands; approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Yin Jishan memorialized on western frontier defense, urging careful selection of capable Anxi officers, ample stockpiles of firearms and ammunition, advance accumulation of supplies, construction of fortifications, and selection of pasturelands; the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，改安西提督為巴里坤提督，設哈密副將以下將領八，兵八百，餘裁改有差。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the Anxi provincial military commander was changed to the Barkol provincial military commander; a Hami deputy commander and officers below, eight in all, with 800 troops, were established; the remainder was abolished or changed with variations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, the Anxi provincial military commander was redesignated the Barkol provincial military commander; a Hami deputy commander and seven subordinate officers commanding 800 troops were established, while the remainder was abolished or adjusted as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 尋改設烏魯木齊總兵官，分中、左、右營及城守營，隸巴里坤提督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward a Urumqi regional commander was established, with center, left, and right battalions and a city-garrison camp, subordinate to the Barkol provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward a Urumqi regional commander was appointed, with center, left, and right battalions and a city-garrison camp subordinate to the Barkol provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 凡巴里坤、烏魯木齊將領官兵，歸陝甘總督統屬。

translations.literal: All officers and troops at Barkol and Urumqi came under the unified command of the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: All officers and troops at Barkol and Urumqi were placed under the unified command of the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，大小金川平，新入版圖，屯兵駐守，制同內地，設懋功、綏靖、崇化、撫邊、慶寧等營，置游擊、守備等官，兵共二千六百有奇。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, after the pacification of Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, the newly annexed territory was garrisoned with troops under the same system as the interior; camps including Maogong, Suijing, Chonghua, Fubian, and Qingning were established, with brigade commanders, garrison commanders, and other officers, totaling slightly more than 2,600 troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 (1776), after the pacification of Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, the newly annexed territory was garrisoned under the same system as the interior, with camps including Maogong, Suijing, Chonghua, Fubian, and Qingning staffed by brigade commanders, garrison commanders, and other officers, for a total strength of slightly over 2,600 men.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，以陝甘總督福康安言，甘肅原設額兵五萬六千六百人，陝西額兵三萬四千五百九十人，迭經移駐裁併，存兵五萬五千九百餘，減原額過半。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, following Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Fuk'anggan's report, Gansu's original quota was 56,600 troops and Shaanxi's 34,590; after repeated transfers, garrisons, and cuts, 55,900-odd remained, a reduction of more than half the original quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, following Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Fuk'anggan's report, Gansu's original quota stood at 56,600 troops and Shaanxi's at 34,590; after repeated transfers, garrisons, and cuts, only 55,900-odd remained—more than half the original quota had been eliminated.

sentences.zh: 嗣增兵萬二千七百餘，合舊存兵額凡七萬人。

translations.literal: Thereafter 12,700-odd troops were added, bringing the combined old and new quota to 70,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently 12,700-odd troops were added, bringing the combined existing and new quota to 70,000 men.

sentences.zh: 而州縣墩戍兵力猶單，請於平涼等府州縣各增兵額，墩堡四十四座，於各標兵內酌選移駐，從之。

translations.literal: Yet the garrison strength at prefecture, county, and blockhouse posts remained thin; it was requested that troop quotas be increased in prefectures and counties including Pingliang, with forty-four blockhouses, selecting troops from existing garrison battalions for transfer; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet garrison strength at prefectural, county, and blockhouse posts remained inadequate; the court approved a request to increase troop quotas in prefectures and counties including Pingliang, establishing forty-four blockhouses and selecting troops from existing garrison battalions for transfer.

sentences.zh: 旋議再增兵三千。

translations.literal: Soon it was proposed to add another 3,000 troops.
translations.idiomatic: A further proposal followed to add 3,000 troops.

sentences.zh: 又議陝、甘各營兵習弓矢、鳥槍、馬上槍箭，每日在本營習技，五日小合操，十日大合操，演九進十連環陣法，練勁旅三萬人。

translations.literal: It was also proposed that troops in each Shaanxi and Gansu camp practice bows and arrows, muskets, and mounted musketry; daily drill within their own camps, small combined exercises every five days, large combined exercises every ten days, performing the nine-advances ten-linked-rings formation, training an elite force of 30,000.
translations.idiomatic: It was also proposed that troops in each Shaanxi and Gansu camp train in bows and arrows, muskets, and mounted musketry—daily drill within their own camps, small combined exercises every five days, large combined exercises every ten days, practicing the nine-advances ten-linked-rings formation to build an elite force of 30,000 men.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，諭提、鎮不得私立旗牌、伴當等名，致侵兵額。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, an edict ordered provincial military commanders and garrison commanders not to establish private name-plates, attendants, and the like, lest they encroach on troop quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year, an edict forbade provincial military commanders and garrison commanders from maintaining private name-plates, attendants, and the like, lest they encroach on authorized troop quotas.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，以剿辦教匪，各省額兵徵調四齣，令各省召募補充。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, to suppress the White Lotus sect rebels, four-tenths of each province's quota troops were mobilized, and the provinces were ordered to recruit replacements.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 (1799), to suppress the White Lotus sect rebels, four-tenths of each province's quota troops were mobilized, and the provinces were ordered to recruit replacements.

sentences.zh: 五年，陝西設寧陝鎮總兵、副將以下官，咸如昔制。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Ningshan garrison town regional commander and officers below were established in Shaanxi, all according to the former system.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, a Ningshan garrison town regional commander and subordinate officers were established in Shaanxi, all according to the former system.

sentences.zh: 十年，諭各督、撫、提、鎮，以練習鄉勇法練習綠旗兵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, an edict ordered all governors-general, governors, provincial military commanders, and garrison commanders to train Green Standard troops using the militia training method.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, an edict directed all governors-general, governors, provincial military commanders, and garrison commanders to train Green Standard troops using the militia training method.

sentences.zh: 道光五年，諭直隸備戰兵萬五千三百有奇，演習車砲陣式。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Daoguang, an edict ordered Zhili's combat-ready troops, 15,300-odd in number, to drill in wheeled-artillery formations.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 5 (1825), an edict directed Zhili's 15,300-odd combat-ready troops to drill in wheeled-artillery formations.

sentences.zh: 旋即議裁。

translations.literal: Soon afterward it was proposed to cut them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward a proposal was made to abolish them.

sentences.zh: 十六年，諭直隸營兵以四成習弓矢，二成習步槍兼馬槍，其刀矛二技，令藤牌軍盡習之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, an edict ordered Zhili camp troops to practice bows and arrows at forty percent, musketry on foot combined with mounted musketry at twenty percent, and the two skills of sword and spear to be fully practiced by rattan-shield troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, an edict directed Zhili camp troops to devote forty percent to bow and arrow drill, twenty percent to foot and mounted musketry, and to have rattan-shield troops fully trained in sword and spear.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，直隸蘆台增設通永鎮總兵官，以北塘、海口等十五營均歸統屬，分三營，設游擊、守備等將領，新鎮標兵凡五千四百餘，專操水陸技藝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, a Tongyong garrison town regional commander was additionally established at Lutai in Zhili; fifteen camps including Beitang and Haikou were all placed under his command, divided into three battalions, with brigade commanders, garrison commanders, and other officers; the new garrison's garrison troops totaled 5,400-odd, specializing in land and naval skills.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, a Tongyong garrison town regional commander was added at Lutai in Zhili, placing fifteen camps including Beitang and Haikou under his command in three battalions with brigade commanders, garrison commanders, and other officers; the new garrison's troops totaled 5,400-odd men, specializing in land and naval skills.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，河南歸德營升為鎮，設總兵官、左右營都司、游擊等，馬兵五百八十，步兵千一百有奇。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng, the Guide camp in Henan was promoted to a garrison town, with a regional commander, left and right battalion company commanders, brigade commanders, and others established; 580 cavalry and slightly more than 1,100 infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 8 (1858), Henan's Guide camp was promoted to a garrison town, with a regional commander, left and right battalion company commanders, brigade commanders, and others appointed—580 cavalry and slightly over 1,100 infantry.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，諭專設總督之直隸、江南、四川、甘肅及督、撫同城之福建、廣東、湖北由總督會同提督節制。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, an edict ordered that in Zhili, Jiangnan, Sichuan, and Gansu, which had dedicated governor-generals, and in Fujian, Guangdong, and Hubei, where governor-general and governor shared the same city, control was exercised jointly by the governor-general together with the provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 (1862), an edict directed that in Zhili, Jiangnan, Sichuan, and Gansu—which had dedicated governor-generals—and in Fujian, Guangdong, and Hubei—where governor-general and governor shared the same city—military control was to be exercised jointly by the governor-general and the provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 其江蘇、浙江、安徽、江西、陝西、湖南、廣西、貴州各鎮兵，就近由巡撫節制。

translations.literal: The garrison troops of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Jiangxi, Shaanxi, Hunan, Guangxi, and Guizhou were placed under the nearby governor's control.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison troops of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Jiangxi, Shaanxi, Hunan, Guangxi, and Guizhou were placed under the control of the provincial governor in each case.

sentences.zh: 四年，增安徽皖南鎮總兵官，設將領弁兵如制。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, a southern Anhui garrison town regional commander was added in Anhui, with officers, ranks, and troops according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, a southern Anhui garrison town regional commander was added in Anhui, with officers, ranks, and troops established according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 六年，諭寧夏鎮綠營兵原額七千，陝西定邊協原額千人，回匪亂後，存者寥寥，咸令補足。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict noted that the Ningxia garrison Green Standard Army's original quota was 7,000 and the Shaanxi Dingbian brigade's original quota 1,000; after the Muslim rebellion, scarcely any remained, and all were ordered made up to full strength.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, an edict noted that the Ningxia garrison Green Standard Army's original quota was 7,000 and the Shaanxi Dingbian brigade's 1,000; after the Muslim rebellion scarcely any remained, and all were ordered brought back to full strength.

sentences.zh: 九年，改廣東赤溪營為水師，隸陽江鎮統轄，變通巡洋舊章。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Chixi camp in Guangdong was converted to a naval force, placed under the Yangjiang garrison's command, modifying the old coastal patrol regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Guangdong's Chixi camp was converted to a naval detachment under the Yangjiang garrison's command, modifying the old coastal patrol regulations.

sentences.zh: 又移湖北武昌城守營分防金口、簰洲二汛。

translations.literal: The Wuchang city-garrison camp in Hubei was also moved to guard the Jinkou and Paizhou guard posts separately.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's Wuchang city-garrison camp was also redeployed to guard the Jinkou and Paizhou guard posts separately.

sentences.zh: 十二年，于山西南北二鎮選兵一千，分二營，設將領訓練。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, 1,000 troops were selected from Shanxi's northern and southern garrisons, divided into two battalions, with officers appointed for training.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, 1,000 troops were selected from Shanxi's northern and southern garrisons, organized into two battalions with officers appointed for training.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，以廣西南邊二千餘里，原設隘一百九，分卡六十六，兵力猶單，分要處為三路，鎮南關口關前隘憑祥土州為中路，自關以東諸隘為東路，以西諸隘為西路，就原有防軍二十二營並為二十四營，以十二營專防中路，餘十二營分防東、西路。
