translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Guangxu, because Guangxi's southern border extended more than 2,000 li, with 109 original passes and 66 checkpoint stations yet still insufficient force, the key points were divided into three routes: the middle route comprised Zhennanguan, Guanqian Pass, and Pingxiang Subprefecture; passes east of the pass formed the eastern route and those west the western route; the original twenty-two garrison battalions were consolidated into twenty-four, twelve dedicated to the middle route and the remaining twelve split between the eastern and western routes.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 (1885), with Guangxi's southern border extending more than 2,000 li and its 109 original passes and 66 checkpoint stations still inadequately garrisoned, key points were divided into three routes—the middle route covering Zhennanguan, Guanqian Pass, and Pingxiang Subprefecture, the eastern route covering passes east of the border, and the western route those to the west; the original twenty-two garrison battalions were consolidated into twenty-four, twelve dedicated to the middle route and the remaining twelve split between the eastern and western routes.

sentences.zh: 廣西提督自柳州移駐龍州。

translations.literal: The Guangxi provincial military commander moved his garrison from Liuzhou to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi provincial military commander relocated his headquarters from Liuzhou to Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 其城守營設游擊及守備等。

translations.literal: Its city-garrison camp had brigade commanders, garrison commanders, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Its city-garrison camp was staffed with brigade commanders, garrison commanders, and other officers.

sentences.zh: 增設柳慶鎮總兵官，駐柳州。

translations.literal: A Liuqing garrison town regional commander was additionally established, garrisoned at Liuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Liuqing garrison town regional commander was added, based at Liuzhou.

sentences.zh: 綠營歷年增損規制，大略如是。

translations.literal: The Green Standard Army's increases and reductions over the years were broadly as described.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army's increases and reductions over the years were broadly as described above.

sentences.zh: 其移駐編改，節目不能覙縷以詳也。

translations.literal: As for transfers, garrisons, and reorganizations, the particulars cannot be enumerated in full detail.
translations.idiomatic: As for transfers, garrisons, and reorganizations, the particulars cannot be set forth in exhaustive detail.

sentences.zh: 若其裁汰之數，自順治中，所裁山西標兵四千餘，陝、甘將領四十八，兵一萬六百餘，河南五百，湖廣五千，江西三千，將領八，江南萬九千餘，將領百十七，其最多者也。

translations.literal: As for the numbers cut, from the Shunzhi period the largest reductions were: Shanxi garrison troops 4,000-odd; Shaanxi and Gansu forty-eight officers and 10,600-odd troops; Henan 500; Huguang 5,000; Jiangxi 3,000 and eight officers; Jiangnan 19,000-odd and 117 officers.
translations.idiomatic: As for the numbers abolished, from the Shunzhi period the largest cuts were: 4,000-odd Shanxi garrison troops; forty-eight officers and 10,600-odd troops in Shaanxi and Gansu; 500 in Henan; 5,000 in Huguang; 3,000 troops and eight officers in Jiangxi; and 19,000-odd troops and 117 officers in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 餘者海州一協，裁將領七，兵六百餘，臨清一鎮，裁將領五，兵一千，三營兵五百，沂州鎮裁將領九，臨清城守營將領五，兵三百，壽張營兵二百。

translations.literal: The remainder included one Haizhou brigade, cutting seven officers and 600-odd troops; one Linqing garrison town, cutting five officers and 1,000 troops; three battalions 500 troops; Yizhou garrison town cutting nine officers; Linqing city-garrison camp five officers and 300 troops; Shouzhang camp 200 troops.
translations.idiomatic: Smaller cuts included one Haizhou brigade—seven officers and 600-odd troops; one Linqing garrison town—five officers and 1,000 troops; three battalions totaling 500 troops; the Yizhou garrison town—nine officers; the Linqing city-garrison camp—five officers and 300 troops; and the Shouzhang camp—200 troops.

sentences.zh: 又裁江西及南贛撫標二營官兵，四川撫標、湖北及鄖陽撫標各二營官兵，多少不等。

translations.literal: Also cut were officers and troops of two Jiangxi battalions and the southern Ganzhou governor's battalions; Sichuan governor's battalions; and two battalions each for Hubei and the Xunyang governor, in varying numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Further cuts affected officers and troops of two Jiangxi battalions and the southern Ganzhou governor's battalions, the Sichuan governor's battalions, and two battalions each for Hubei and the Xunyang governor, in varying numbers.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，裁辰常鎮總兵，設辰州協標官兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi, the Chenchang garrison regional commander was cut and Chenzhou brigade garrison officers and troops were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 (1669), the Chenchang garrison regional commander was abolished and Chenzhou brigade garrison officers and troops were established in his place.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，裁崇明提督，設崇明水師總兵，定三營及奇兵營制。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, the Chongming provincial military commander was cut and a Chongming naval regional commander was established, fixing the system of three battalions and an irregular-troop battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, the Chongming provincial military commander was abolished and a Chongming naval regional commander was appointed, with a fixed organization of three battalions and an irregular-troop battalion.

sentences.zh: 三十四年後，計所裁標兵，南贛鎮千餘，九江協九百餘，銅鼓營兵八百餘為最多，餘者自四、五百以下，少至六、七人。

translations.literal: After thirty-four years, counting the garrison troops cut: the southern Ganzhou garrison town over one thousand, the Jiujiang brigade over nine hundred, and the Tonggu camp over eight hundred were the largest; the rest ranged from four or five hundred down, with as few as six or seven men.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-four years later, when the garrison troops abolished were totaled up, the largest cuts were at the southern Ganzhou garrison town—over a thousand men—the Jiujiang brigade—over nine hundred—and the Tonggu camp—over eight hundred. The rest ranged from four or five hundred down to as few as six or seven men.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，裁撫標新設二營，餘所裁最多三百餘，最少十人、九人。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, two newly established governor's garrison battalions were cut; among the rest, the largest cut was over three hundred, the smallest nine or ten men.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign, two newly established governor's garrison battalions were abolished. Among the remaining cuts, the largest was over three hundred men and the smallest as few as nine or ten.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十九年，諭各標額兵六十二萬四千餘，較雍、乾以來所增實多，令督、撫、提、鎮量加裁汰。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Jiaqing, an edict stated that quota troops at all garrison standards totaled over 624,000—far more than had been added since the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns—and ordered governors-general, governors, provincial military commanders, and regional commanders to measure additional cuts.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 19 (1814), an edict noted that quota troops under all garrison standards numbered over 624,000—far exceeding the increases made since the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns—and ordered governors-general, governors, provincial military commanders, and regional commanders to carry out further measured reductions.

sentences.zh: 於是次第減萬四千有奇。

translations.literal: Thereupon reductions proceeded in sequence to over fourteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Reductions were then carried out in stages, totaling over fourteen thousand men.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，又諭各省勿糜餉以養額兵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, another edict instructed the provinces not to squander pay maintaining quota troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, another edict instructed the provinces not to squander rations maintaining troops on the regular establishment.

sentences.zh: 道光中，裁陝、甘綠營馬兵三千六百餘。

translations.literal: During the Daoguang reign, over 3,600 Green Standard cavalry in Shaanxi and Gansu were cut.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daoguang reign, over 3,600 Green Standard cavalry in Shaanxi and Gansu were abolished.

sentences.zh: 又裁山東、山西撫標，及兗州等三鎮，太原、大同二鎮，東河河標，雲、貴督、撫、鎮、協各標兵額，暨福建水陸各營，浙江馬、步兵，兩廣、江蘇、安徽馬、步、守兵各有差。

translations.literal: Also cut were the Shandong and Shanxi governors' garrison troops; three garrison towns including Yanzhou; the Taiyuan and Datong garrison towns; the Eastern Canal river garrison standard; the garrison troop quotas of the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, governors, garrison towns, and brigades; Fujian's land and naval camps; Zhejiang cavalry and infantry; and the cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops of the Two Guang, Jiangsu, and Anhui, each to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Further cuts affected the Shandong and Shanxi governors' garrison troops; three garrison towns including Yanzhou; the Taiyuan and Datong garrison towns; the Eastern Canal river garrison standard; the garrison troop quotas of the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, governors, garrison towns, and brigades; Fujian's land and naval camps; Zhejiang cavalry and infantry; and the cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops of the Two Guang, Jiangsu, and Anhui, each to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，曾國籓疏言：「八旗勁旅，以強半翊衛京師，以少半駐防天下，而山海要隘，往往布滿，其額數常不過三十五萬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, Zeng Guofan memorialized: "The Eight Banners' elite forces—slightly more than half guard the capital, slightly less than half garrison the realm—and strategic mountain and sea passes are often fully manned; their quota never exceeds 350,000."
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 (1851), Zeng Guofan memorialized: "The Eight Banners' elite forces—slightly more than half guard the capital, while slightly less than half garrison the realm—and strategic mountain and sea passes are often fully manned. Their total establishment never exceeds 350,000 men."

sentences.zh: 綠營兵名為六十餘萬，其實缺額常六、七萬人。

translations.literal: Green Standard troops were nominally over 600,000, but vacancies usually ran to sixty or seventy thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army was nominally over 600,000 strong, but vacancies usually ran to sixty or seventy thousand men.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中葉，增兵議起。

translations.literal: In the mid-Qianlong period, debate over increasing troops arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the mid-Qianlong period, proposals to increase troop strength were raised.

sentences.zh: 向之空名坐糧，悉令補足，一舉而增兵逾六萬。

translations.literal: Former phantom rolls that drew pay without men were all ordered filled, and in one stroke troops increased by over sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Phantom rolls that had drawn pay without men were all ordered filled, and in a single stroke the army grew by over sixty thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 經費驟加，大學士阿桂爭之不得。

translations.literal: Funds suddenly increased, and Grand Secretary Agui objected without success.
translations.idiomatic: Military expenditures suddenly surged, and Grand Secretary Agui objected in vain.

sentences.zh: 至嘉慶、道光間，睹帑藏之漸絀，思阿桂之遠慮，特詔裁兵，而兩次所裁僅一萬六千。

translations.literal: By the Jiaqing and Daoguang periods, seeing the treasury gradually depleted and recalling Agui's foresight, a special edict ordered troop cuts, yet the two rounds cut only sixteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: By the Jiaqing and Daoguang periods, as the treasury gradually emptied and Agui's foresight came to mind, special edicts ordered troop reductions—yet two rounds of cuts eliminated only sixteen thousand men.

sentences.zh: 請飭各省留強汰弱，復乾隆初制。

translations.literal: He requested that the provinces be ordered to retain the strong and eliminate the weak, restoring the early Qianlong system.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that the provinces be ordered to retain the strong and eliminate the weak, restoring the system of early Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 」諭如所請，命各督、撫分三年裁復舊額，所裁之數，年終匯陳，不得再有空糧之弊。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request and ordered each governor-general and governor, over three years, to cut back to the old quotas; the numbers cut were to be reported at year's end, and the abuse of phantom pay was not to recur.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request and ordered each governor-general and governor to restore the old quotas over three years, report the numbers cut at year's end, and ensure that the abuse of phantom pay did not recur.

sentences.zh: 四年，裁山西馬、步、守兵五千八百餘，雲南步、守兵三千九百餘。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, over 5,800 Shanxi cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops were cut, and over 3,900 Yunnan infantry and garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, over 5,800 Shanxi cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops were cut, along with over 3,900 Yunnan infantry and garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，裁九江、洞庭、岳州、荊州等水師營，改城守營，並酌設陸汛。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tongzhi, the Jiujiang, Dongting, Yuezhou, Jingzhou, and other naval camps were cut, converted into city-garrison camps, and land patrol posts were established as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8 (1869), the Jiujiang, Dongting, Yuezhou, Jingzhou, and other naval camps were abolished, converted into city-garrison camps, and land guard posts were established as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，左宗棠、楊昌濬疏言：「軍興未收制兵之效，由餉薄而額多，不能應時精練，兵不練與無兵同，練不精與不練同。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, Zuo Zongtang and Yang Changjun memorialized: "Military campaigns have not yielded results from regular establishment troops, because pay is thin and quotas are large and timely drilling cannot be thorough; undrilled troops are no better than none, and poorly drilled troops are no better than undrilled ones."
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 (1879), Zuo Zongtang and Yang Changjun memorialized: "Campaign after campaign has failed to make regular establishment troops effective. Pay is too thin and quotas too large for timely, thorough drilling. Undrilled troops are no better than none, and poorly drilled troops are no better than undrilled ones."

sentences.zh: 甘肅賦少兵多，軍實向資他省，餉源稍絀，動滋事端。

translations.literal: Gansu had low tax revenue and many troops; military supplies had long relied on other provinces, and when pay sources were strained incidents easily arose.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu had low tax revenue but many troops; its military supplies had long depended on other provinces, and whenever pay sources ran short, trouble quickly followed.

sentences.zh: 亟宜量減可裁之兵，以節餉糈，即以所裁軍餉加所留之兵，庶可責其勤練。

translations.literal: It was urgently appropriate to measure a reduction of troops that could be cut, to save rations, and to add the pay of the troops cut to those retained, so that diligent drilling could be demanded of them.
translations.idiomatic: Troops that could be cut should be reduced without delay to save rations, and the pay of those eliminated should be added to those retained, so that diligent drilling could finally be demanded of them.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，甘兵定額較內地為多，後雖陸續裁減，計尚存馬、步、守兵五萬七千餘。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period, Gansu's fixed quotas were larger than those in the interior; though reductions followed in succession, over 57,000 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops still remained.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng, Gansu's regular establishment was larger than that of the interior provinces. Though successive cuts followed, over 57,000 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops still remained.

sentences.zh: 即須分成核減。

translations.literal: These had to be proportionally verified and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: These had to be proportionally verified and reduced.

sentences.zh: 」六年，丁寶楨言：「四川自軍興後，招募營勇，裁者少而增者多。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Ding Baozhen stated: "Since military campaigns began in Sichuan, camp braves have been recruited—few cut, many added."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Ding Baozhen stated: "Since the outbreak of war in Sichuan, camp braves have been recruited—few cut, many added."

sentences.zh: 同治間，楚、黔、川勇多至六萬餘。

translations.literal: During the Tongzhi period, Chu, Guizhou, and Sichuan braves reached over sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi period, braves from Chu, Guizhou, and Sichuan reached over sixty thousand.

sentences.zh: 次第裁撤，至今存營勇二千九百餘，尚可裁其什一。

translations.literal: They were progressively disbanded; today over 2,900 camp braves remain, and one tenth can still be cut.
translations.idiomatic: They were progressively disbanded; today over 2,900 camp braves remain, and a further tenth can still be cut.

sentences.zh: 」是歲，湖南各營弁兵及水陸防勇次第裁者四千三百餘，湖北裁者三千二百餘，安徽陸續裁者約九千餘。

translations.literal: That year, over 4,300 officers and troops of Hunan's camps and land and naval defense braves were cut in succession; over 3,200 in Hubei; and about 9,000 in Anhui through successive reductions.
translations.idiomatic: That year, over 4,300 officers and troops from Hunan's camps and land and naval defense braves were cut in succession; over 3,200 in Hubei; and about 9,000 in Anhui through successive reductions.

sentences.zh: 八年，張曜疏言：「裁汰勇丁，即可規復兵額，變通營制，方能永固邊防。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Zhang Yao memorialized: "Cutting braves will allow restoration of troop quotas; adapting the camp system is the only way to secure the border defenses permanently."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Zhang Yao memorialized: "Cutting braves will allow restoration of the regular establishment; only by adapting the camp system can the border defenses be secured permanently."

sentences.zh: 」九年，張之洞奏整頓山西綠營練軍，裁湘軍正勇千人，設籌資遣，尋復裁汰，綜合前後裁兵約及六千人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zhang Zhidong memorialized on reorganizing the Shanxi Green Standard drilled troops, cut one thousand regular Hunan Army braves, set aside funds for dismissal, and soon cut again; counting earlier and later cuts, troops reduced totaled about six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Zhang Zhidong memorialized on reorganizing the Shanxi Green Standard drilled troops, cut one thousand regular Hunan Army braves, set aside funds for their dismissal, and soon ordered further cuts. Counting earlier and later reductions together, about six thousand troops were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 時貴州制兵裁汰二成，守兵裁者三千二百餘，戰兵二千九百餘。

translations.literal: At the time, Guizhou's regular establishment troops were cut by twenty percent: over 3,200 garrison troops and over 2,900 combat troops.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Guizhou's regular establishment troops were cut by twenty percent—over 3,200 garrison troops and over 2,900 combat troops.

sentences.zh: 江西額兵萬一千九百餘，近始以制兵作練軍，然長年調練，冒替弊生，遂有「兵止一人，人已三變」之誚。

translations.literal: Jiangxi's quota troops numbered over 11,900; only recently had regular establishment troops been made into drilled troops, but long-term rotation for drill produced impersonation abuses, giving rise to the mockery that "only one soldier remained on the rolls while three men had already changed."
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's quota troops numbered over 11,900. Only recently had regular establishment troops been converted into drilled troops, but long-term rotation for drill bred impersonation abuses, giving rise to the mockery that "only one soldier remained on the rolls while three men had already changed."

sentences.zh: 因定撫標選鋒仍舊操練，裁外屬各營抽練之軍，悉回原汛。

translations.literal: Therefore it was fixed that the governor's garrison elite selection would continue drilling as before, the extracted-drill forces of subordinate camps would be cut, and all would return to their original guard posts.
translations.idiomatic: It was therefore decided that the governor's garrison elite selection would continue drilling as before, that extracted-drill forces from subordinate camps would be abolished, and that all would return to their original guard posts.

sentences.zh: 十一年，諭直省裁汰綠營。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict ordered all provinces to cut the Green Standard Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, an edict ordered all provinces to cut the Green Standard Army.

sentences.zh: 卞寶第言：「廣西額兵二萬三千，土兵一萬四千。

translations.literal: Bian Baodi stated: "Guangxi has 23,000 quota troops and 14,000 native troops."
translations.idiomatic: Bian Baodi stated: "Guangxi has 23,000 quota troops and 14,000 native troops."

sentences.zh: 粵逆初起，不過二千人。

translations.literal: When the Guangdong rebels first rose, they numbered no more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When the Guangdong rebels first rose, they numbered no more than two thousand men.

sentences.zh: 合此巨數之兵，不能擊少數之賊。

translations.literal: Combined, this huge army could not defeat a small band of rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Combined, this vast force could not defeat a small band of rebels.

sentences.zh: 廣西如此，他可類推。

translations.literal: If Guangxi was thus, others could be inferred by analogy.
translations.idiomatic: If Guangxi was thus, the same could be inferred for the other provinces.

sentences.zh: 自後發、捻、回、苗恣亂，綠營戰績無聞。

translations.literal: Afterward, as the Taiping, Nian, Muslim, and Miao rebellions raged unchecked, no Green Standard battle achievements were heard of.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, as the Taiping, Nian, Muslim, and Miao rebellions raged unchecked, the Green Standard Army won no renown in battle.

sentences.zh: 今宜以漸變通營制，裁額並糧，以兩餉挑一兵。

translations.literal: Now the camp system should gradually be adapted, quotas cut and rations combined, and two soldiers' pay used to select one soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Now the camp system should gradually be reformed: quotas cut and rations combined, with the pay of two soldiers used to support one selected man.

sentences.zh: 如額兵一萬，分二十營，一半駐守，一半巡防。

translations.literal: For example, with ten thousand quota troops divided into twenty camps, half would garrison and half patrol.
translations.idiomatic: For example, ten thousand quota troops might be divided into twenty camps, half to garrison and half to patrol.

sentences.zh: 無事則計日操防，有警則隨時援應。

translations.literal: When there was no emergency they would drill and patrol by schedule; when alarm arose they would respond as needed.
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime they would drill and patrol on a fixed schedule; when alarm arose they would respond as needed.

sentences.zh: 綠營積習，無許復存。

translations.literal: The Green Standard Army's accumulated abuses were not to be permitted to remain.
translations.idiomatic: None of the Green Standard Army's accumulated abuses were to be permitted to remain.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，諭：「近者戶部奏請裁兵，宜汰綠營七成，勇營三成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, an edict stated: "Recently the Board of Revenue memorialized requesting troop cuts: the Green Standard Army should be reduced by seventy percent and braves camps by thirty percent."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, an edict stated: "Recently the Board of Revenue memorialized requesting troop cuts: the Green Standard Army should be reduced by seventy percent and braves camps by thirty percent."

sentences.zh: 通諭以來，惟山東陳明分限五年裁減五成，此外酌裁無幾。

translations.literal: Since the circular edict, only Shandong had clearly stated a five-year limit to cut fifty percent; otherwise few measured cuts had been made.
translations.idiomatic: Since the circular edict went out, only Shandong had clearly stated a five-year plan to cut fifty percent; otherwise few measured reductions had been made.

sentences.zh: 綜各省兵勇尚八十萬有餘，歲餉約共三千餘萬。

translations.literal: Counting all provinces, troops and braves still exceeded 800,000, with annual pay totaling about thirty million taels.
translations.idiomatic: Counting all provinces together, troops and braves still exceeded 800,000, with annual pay totaling about thirty million taels.

sentences.zh: 綠營積惰，久成虛設。

translations.literal: The Green Standard Army's accumulated sloth had long made it a hollow institution.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army's accumulated sloth had long reduced it to a hollow institution.

sentences.zh: 當茲借款期迫，棄有用之餉，養無用之兵，因之國窮民蹙。

translations.literal: At a time when loan deadlines pressed, useful pay was abandoned to maintain useless troops, and thus the state grew poor and the people were squeezed.
translations.idiomatic: At a time when loan deadlines pressed, useful funds were squandered to maintain useless troops, leaving the state impoverished and the people squeezed.

sentences.zh: 各將軍、督、撫亟應定限切實裁減以聞。

translations.literal: All generals, governors-general, and governors should urgently set deadlines and carry out real cuts, then report.
translations.idiomatic: All generals, governors-general, and governors should urgently set deadlines, carry out real cuts, and report back.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從胡燏棻等言，裁併綠營、練勇，選練新操。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, following the advice of Hu Yi'e and others, the Green Standard Army and drilled braves were cut and merged, and new drill routines were selected.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, following the advice of Hu Yi'e and others, the Green Standard Army and drilled braves were cut and merged, and new drill routines were adopted.

sentences.zh: 時山東兵額已陸續裁十之三。

translations.literal: At the time, Shandong's troop quotas had already been cut by thirty percent in succession.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Shandong's troop quotas had already been reduced by thirty percent in successive stages.

sentences.zh: 至是以不敷分配，未裁之二成，仍止不裁。

translations.literal: Now, because funds were insufficient for distribution, the remaining uncut twenty percent was still halted from being cut.
translations.idiomatic: Now, because funds were insufficient to distribute, the remaining uncut twenty percent was left untouched.

sentences.zh: 於是山西以汰存兵額不敷防卡之用，請增練新軍數營。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shanxi, because the remaining troops after cuts were insufficient for guard post defense, requested the addition of several new drilled army camps.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Shanxi, finding that the remaining troops after cuts were insufficient for guard post defense, requested the addition of several new drilled army camps.

sentences.zh: 恭壽亦言綠營弊深，屢裁而益弱，須藉民力以輔之，宜急行團練。

translations.literal: Gong Shou also stated that Green Standard abuses ran deep, repeated cuts only made it weaker, the populace's strength had to be relied upon to assist, and militia training should be urgently carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Shou also stated that Green Standard abuses ran deep, that repeated cuts only made the army weaker, that the populace's strength had to be enlisted to assist, and that militia training should be urgently carried out.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，劉坤一、張之洞奏汰綠營，言：「綠營官皆選補，兵皆土著。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong memorialized on eliminating the Green Standard Army, stating: "Green Standard officers were all selected appointments, and the troops were all local natives."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong memorialized on eliminating the Green Standard Army, stating: "Green Standard officers were all selected appointments, and the troops were all local natives."

sentences.zh: 兵非弁之所自招，弁非將之所親信，既無恩義，自難鈐束。

translations.literal: The troops were not recruited by the company commanders, and the company commanders were not the generals' trusted men; without bonds of grace and duty, restraint was naturally difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The troops were not recruited by the company commanders, and the company commanders were not the generals' trusted men. Without bonds of grace and duty, restraint was naturally impossible.

sentences.zh: 以傳舍之官，馭世業之兵，亦如州縣之於吏役，欲其整飭變化，服教從風，此必無之事。

translations.literal: Using transient officials to command hereditary troops was like prefects and counties dealing with clerks and runners: to expect them to reform and change, accept instruction, and follow the trend—this was impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Using transient officials to command hereditary troops was like prefects and magistrates dealing with clerks and runners. To expect them to reform, accept instruction, and follow new ways was impossible.

sentences.zh: 況綠營將弁，薰染官習，官弁且不易教，況於兵乎！

translations.literal: Moreover, Green Standard generals and officers were steeped in bureaucratic habits; if the officers were hard to teach, how much more the troops!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Green Standard generals and officers were steeped in bureaucratic habits. If the officers themselves were hard to teach, how much more the troops!

sentences.zh: 層層積弊，已入膏肓，既甚驕頑，又極疲弱，本難練成可用之兵，自非裁汰不可。

translations.literal: Abuses had accumulated layer upon layer to a terminal state: the troops were both extremely arrogant and stubborn and extremely weak; they were originally hard to drill into usable soldiers, and cuts were unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: Abuses had accumulated layer upon layer to a terminal state. The troops were both extremely arrogant and stubborn and extremely weak. They could not be drilled into usable soldiers, and cuts were unavoidable.

sentences.zh: 惟有分年漸裁一策，不分馬、步、戰、守，每年裁二十分之一，計百人裁五，限二十年而竣。

translations.literal: Only the strategy of gradual yearly cuts remained: regardless of cavalry, infantry, combat, or garrison troops, one twentieth would be cut each year—five out of every hundred—and the process would be completed within twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Only the strategy of gradual yearly cuts remained. Regardless of cavalry, infantry, combat, or garrison troops, one twentieth would be cut each year—five out of every hundred—and the process would be completed within twenty years.

sentences.zh: 計成扣餉，按次銷除，即以節省之餉，作緝捕營察之用。

translations.literal: Pay would be calculated and withheld, eliminated in sequence, and the saved rations would be used for patrol, arrest, and garrison police duties.
translations.idiomatic: Pay would be calculated and withheld, eliminated in sequence, and the saved rations would be used for patrol, arrest, and garrison police duties.

sentences.zh: 惟湖南鎮筸鎮，系改土歸流，無土著農戶，除苗產外，地皆屯田，民皆兵籍，綏靖鎮亦然，請於此兩鎮兵額不再裁汰，但將綠營改為勇營。

translations.literal: Only Hunan's Zhengan garrison town, having passed from native chieftain rule to direct administration, had no local farming households; apart from Miao lands, all land was garrison farmland and all people were on military registers—the same was true of the Suijing garrison town. It was requested that these two garrison towns' quotas not be cut further, but that the Green Standard Army there be converted into braves camps.
translations.idiomatic: Only Hunan's Zhengan garrison town, having passed from native chieftain rule to direct administration, had no local farming households. Apart from Miao lands, all land was garrison farmland and all people were on military registers—the same was true of the Suijing garrison town. It was requested that these two garrison towns' quotas not be cut further, but that the Green Standard Army there be converted into braves camps.

sentences.zh: 所裁將領，可用者改隸勇營，不能帶勇者，開缺或改官。

translations.literal: Officers cut from the rolls who were usable would be transferred to braves camps; those who could not lead braves would leave their posts vacant or be transferred to civil office.
translations.idiomatic: Officers cut from the rolls who were still usable would be transferred to braves camps; those who could not lead braves would leave their posts vacant or be transferred to civil office.

sentences.zh: 使武職無把持之弊，合天下兵出於勇營之一途。

translations.literal: Thus military offices would be free of the abuse of monopolized control, and all troops under Heaven would come from the single path of braves camps.
translations.idiomatic: Thus military offices would be free of monopolized control, and all troops under Heaven would come from the single path of braves camps.

sentences.zh: 更定營名，以符名實。

translations.literal: Camp names would be revised to match reality.
translations.idiomatic: Camp names would be revised to match reality.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，從徐世昌等言，以綠營挑改巡警。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, following the advice of Xu Shichang and others, Green Standard troops were selected and converted into police patrol forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, following the advice of Xu Shichang and others, Green Standard troops were selected and converted into police patrol forces.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，步軍統領衙門疏言：「巡捕五營，原設馬、戰制兵萬人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, the Infantry Command memorialized: "The five patrol camps originally had ten thousand regular cavalry and combat troops."
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 (1909), the Infantry Command memorialized: "The five patrol camps originally had ten thousand regular cavalry and combat troops on the establishment."

sentences.zh: 嗣因屢次裁併，中營現兵千五百人，內分馬兵五百四十，戰兵八百六十，簡差戰兵百人。

translations.literal: Subsequently, because of repeated cuts and mergers, the Center Camp presently had 1,500 troops, divided within into 540 cavalry, 860 combat troops, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, because of repeated cuts and mergers, the Center Camp presently had 1,500 troops—540 cavalry, 860 combat troops, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.

sentences.zh: 南營兵千二百五十人，內分馬兵三百二十，戰兵三百三十，簡差戰兵百人。

translations.literal: The South Camp had 1,250 troops, divided within into 320 cavalry, 330 combat troops, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.
translations.idiomatic: The South Camp had 1,250 troops—320 cavalry, 330 combat troops, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.

sentences.zh: 左營兵八百人，內分馬兵三百二十，戰兵三百八十，簡差戰兵百人。

translations.literal: The Left Camp had 800 troops, divided within into 320 cavalry, 380 combat troops, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Camp had 800 troops—320 cavalry, 380 combat troops, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.

sentences.zh: 右營兵七百人，內分馬、戰兵各三百，簡差戰兵百人。

translations.literal: The Right Camp had 700 troops, divided within into 300 cavalry and 300 combat troops each, and 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Camp had 700 troops—300 cavalry and 300 combat troops each, plus 100 combat troops detailed for special duty.

sentences.zh: 惟南營汛地設巡警後，差務較簡，請撥南營兵三百七十五人隸北、左、右三營，每營馬兵各三百六十五人，戰兵四百十人。

translations.literal: Only after police patrol was established in the South Camp's guard post area and duties became lighter, it was requested that 375 South Camp troops be transferred to the North, Left, and Right camps, with each camp having 365 cavalry and 410 combat troops.
translations.idiomatic: After police patrol was established in the South Camp's guard post area and its duties became lighter, it was requested that 375 South Camp troops be transferred to the North, Left, and Right camps, with each camp then having 365 cavalry and 410 combat troops.

sentences.zh: 」是年，免裁之鎮筸、綏靖二鎮，定議改為續備軍。

translations.literal: That year, the Zhengan and Suijing garrison towns exempted from cuts were decided to be converted into reserve armies.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Zhengan and Suijing garrison towns exempted from cuts were decided to be converted into reserve armies.

sentences.zh: 此外乾州、永綏、常德諸協，河溪、保靖等營，留兵各三、四百人，去綠營之名，改勇營規制，作為續備軍。

translations.literal: Beyond this, the Qianzhou, Yongshou, and Changde brigades and the Hexi, Baojing, and other camps each retained three or four hundred troops, dropped the Green Standard name, adopted braves camp regulations, and served as reserve armies.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this, the Qianzhou, Yongshou, and Changde brigades and the Hexi, Baojing, and other camps each retained three or four hundred troops, dropped the Green Standard name, adopted braves camp regulations, and served as reserve armies.

sentences.zh: 岳州、澧州等營，各裁將弁，存兵六十四人或至九十三人。

translations.literal: The Yuezhou, Lizhou, and other camps each cut their officers and retained sixty-four to ninety-three troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuezhou, Lizhou, and other camps each cut their officers and retained between sixty-four and ninety-three troops.

sentences.zh: 其餘撫、提、鎮、協諸營，各裁統將，一以同城將領兼統餘兵。

translations.literal: The remaining governor's, provincial military commander's, garrison town's, and brigade camps each cut their commanding generals, and officers in the same city jointly commanded the remaining troops.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining governor's, provincial military commander's, garrison town's, and brigade camps each cut their commanding generals, and officers in the same city jointly commanded the remaining troops.

sentences.zh: 湖北通省將領，副將五人裁去一人，參將七人裁二人，游擊十七人裁五人，都司十一人裁三人，守備三十三人裁十人。

translations.literal: Province-wide in Hubei, of five deputy regimental vice commanders one was cut; of seven regimental vice commanders two; of seventeen regional commanders five; of eleven garrison commanders three; and of thirty-three company commanders ten.
translations.idiomatic: Province-wide in Hubei, one of five deputy regimental vice commanders was cut; two of seven regimental vice commanders; five of seventeen regional commanders; three of eleven garrison commanders; and ten of thirty-three company commanders.

sentences.zh: 其撫標各營尚未盡裁，俟分軍裁汰。

translations.literal: The governor's garrison camps had not yet been fully cut and awaited phased reduction by separate armies.
translations.idiomatic: The governor's garrison camps had not yet been fully cut and awaited phased reduction by separate armies.

sentences.zh: 是年，裁江北舊役衛兵左右二哨兵。

translations.literal: That year, the left and right platoons of old-service guard troops in Jiangbei were cut.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the left and right platoons of old-service guard troops in Jiangbei were abolished.

sentences.zh: 貴州綠營已裁二成，尋裁副將以下各官，歸併四營，酌改六營，惟邊防要地佐防軍所不及者緩裁。

translations.literal: Guizhou's Green Standard Army had already been cut by twenty percent; soon deputy regimental vice commanders and all officers below were cut, four camps were merged, and six camps were adjusted; only at vital border defense points where auxiliary defense forces could not reach were cuts deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou's Green Standard Army had already been cut by twenty percent. Soon deputy regimental vice commanders and all officers below were cut, four camps were merged and six camps adjusted. Only at vital border defense points where auxiliary defense forces could not reach were cuts deferred.

sentences.zh: 二年，浙江綠營裁汰後，尚餘將領三百九十九，兵七千餘，一律裁盡，收取馬匹軍械，改編巡防隊八營。

translations.literal: In the second year, after Zhejiang's Green Standard cuts, 399 officers and over 7,000 troops still remained; all were cut completely, horses and weapons were collected, and eight patrol defense camps were reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, after Zhejiang's Green Standard cuts, 399 officers and over 7,000 troops still remained. All were abolished completely, horses and weapons were collected, and eight patrol defense camps were reorganized.

sentences.zh: 四川綠營次第裁盡，挑選精壯改練防軍。

translations.literal: Sichuan's Green Standard Army was progressively cut to completion, and the elite and strong were selected and converted into defense troops.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's Green Standard Army was progressively cut to completion, and the elite and strong were selected and converted into defense troops.

sentences.zh: 湖廣營已裁十成之七，一、二年後，即可裁盡。

translations.literal: Huguang's camps had already been cut by seventy percent; in one or two years they could be cut completely.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang's camps had already been cut by seventy percent and could be abolished completely within one or two years.

sentences.zh: 湖北自咸豐八年裁馬兵改步兵，同治八、九年，先後裁撤水陸軍二千一百有奇，馬二百餘匹，光緒十一年以來，又裁二千九百有奇，馬、步、戰、守兵七千六百有奇，馬八百八十餘匹，實存馬、步、守兵共七千餘，馬千六百六十匹，以後分年裁盡。

translations.literal: In Hubei, from Xianfeng 8 cavalry were cut and converted to infantry; in Tongzhi 8 and 9, land and naval forces of over 2,100 and over 200 horses were cut in succession; from Guangxu 11 onward, another over 2,900, over 7,600 cavalry, infantry, combat, and garrison troops, and over 880 horses were cut. Actually remaining were over 7,000 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops and 1,660 horses, to be cut completely in successive years thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei, from Xianfeng 8 (1858) cavalry were cut and converted to infantry. In Tongzhi 8 and 9 (1869–1870), over 2,100 land and naval troops and over 200 horses were cut in succession. From Guangxu 11 (1885) onward, another over 2,900 men, over 7,600 cavalry, infantry, combat, and garrison troops, and over 880 horses were cut. What actually remained were over 7,000 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops and 1,660 horses, to be abolished completely in successive years thereafter.

sentences.zh: 尋湖北之漢陽協興國等營，湖南之衡州協保靖等營，副將以下各官，一律停補。

translations.literal: Soon at Hubei's Hanyang brigade, Xingguo, and other camps and Hunan's Hengzhou brigade, Baojing, and other camps, all officers from deputy regimental vice commander downward ceased to have vacancies filled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon at Hubei's Hanyang brigade, Xingguo, and other camps and Hunan's Hengzhou brigade, Baojing, and other camps, all vacancies from deputy regimental vice commander downward ceased to be filled.

sentences.zh: 裁福建綠營，計至宣統六年裁盡，現存將領三百八十人，步、戰、守、舵、炊、兵夫五千九百有奇。

translations.literal: Fujian's Green Standard Army was being cut, with complete abolition planned by Xuantong 6; presently 380 officers and over 5,900 infantry, combat, garrison, helmsmen, cooks, and soldier-laborers remained.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Green Standard Army was being cut, with complete abolition planned by Xuantong 6 (1914). Presently 380 officers and over 5,900 infantry, combat, garrison, helmsmen, cooks, and soldier-laborers remained.

sentences.zh: 直隸綠營，於同治年間改為練軍。

translations.literal: Zhili's Green Standard Army was converted into drilled troops during the Tongzhi period.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's Green Standard Army was converted into drilled troops during the Tongzhi period.

sentences.zh: 光緒以來，通永等鎮分年裁減，至二十九年，實存馬、步、戰、守兵二萬六千餘人。

translations.literal: From the Guangxu period onward, the Tongzhou-Yongqing and other garrison towns were cut year by year; by the twenty-ninth year, over 26,000 cavalry, infantry, combat, and garrison troops actually remained.
translations.idiomatic: From the Guangxu period onward, the Tongzhou-Yongqing and other garrison towns were cut year by year. By the twenty-ninth year, over 26,000 cavalry, infantry, combat, and garrison troops actually remained.

sentences.zh: 其天津城守及葛沽、通永、通州、北塘等凡十一營，當庚子之變，潰散無餘，遂悉裁撤。

translations.literal: Eleven camps in all—including the Tianjin city garrison and those at Gezhu, Tongzhou-Yongqing, Tongzhou, and Beitang—when the Gengzi incident occurred, scattered completely without remainder and were all disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven camps in all—including the Tianjin city garrison and those at Gezhu, Tongzhou-Yongqing, Tongzhou, and Beitang—scattered completely during the Gengzi incident and were all disbanded.

sentences.zh: 此外各營均十裁其三，復裁將弁三百十四人。

translations.literal: Beyond this, each of the other camps was cut by thirty percent, and 314 officers were further cut.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this, each of the other camps was cut by thirty percent, and 314 officers were further abolished.

sentences.zh: 其大沽六營，庚子年傷亡過甚，亦全裁之，改設巡警。

translations.literal: The six Dagu camps, having suffered excessive casualties in the Gengzi year, were also all cut and replaced with police patrol forces.
translations.idiomatic: The six Dagu camps, having suffered excessive casualties in the Gengzi year, were also all abolished and replaced with police patrol forces.

sentences.zh: 三年，直隸綠營尚存官弁七百餘，兵六千六百餘，實行裁汰，惟淮、練、巡防各營，暫仍其舊。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zhili's Green Standard Army still had over 700 officers and over 6,600 troops, and cuts were actually carried out; only the Huai, drilled, and patrol defense camps temporarily retained their old arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Zhili's Green Standard Army still had over 700 officers and over 6,600 troops, and cuts were actually carried out. Only the Huai, drilled, and patrol defense camps temporarily retained their old arrangements.

sentences.zh: 四川關外原設台兵，向由綠營撥派，共三十九台，將弁兵丁，一律裁撤。

translations.literal: Beyond the Sichuan passes, guard post troops originally established at thirty-nine posts and hitherto assigned from the Green Standard Army had their officers and troops all disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Sichuan passes, guard post troops originally established at thirty-nine posts and hitherto assigned from the Green Standard Army had their officers and troops all disbanded.

sentences.zh: 福建綠營，豫定裁盡年限，所節之餉，編練巡防隊。

translations.literal: For Fujian's Green Standard Army, a deadline for complete cuts was preset, and the saved pay was used to organize and drill patrol defense corps.
translations.idiomatic: For Fujian's Green Standard Army, a deadline for complete abolition was preset, and the saved pay was used to organize and drill patrol defense corps.

sentences.zh: 江西亦擬裁盡綠營。

translations.literal: Jiangxi also planned to cut the Green Standard Army completely.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi also planned to abolish the Green Standard Army completely.

sentences.zh: 甘肅邊要，陸軍尚未成鎮，僅存馬、步、守兵萬七千餘，資其防制之力，暫從緩裁。

translations.literal: At Gansu's vital border points, the army had not yet been formed into garrison towns; only over 17,000 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops remained, and relying on their defensive strength, cuts were temporarily deferred.
translations.idiomatic: At Gansu's vital border points, the army had not yet been formed into garrison towns. Only over 17,000 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops remained, and relying on their defensive strength, cuts were temporarily deferred.

sentences.zh: 山西綠營所存無幾，分三年盡裁之。

translations.literal: Shanxi's Green Standard Army had little remaining and would be cut completely over three years.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi's Green Standard Army had little remaining and would be abolished completely over three years.

sentences.zh: 江南綠營亦然，惟徐州鎮標緩撤。

translations.literal: Jiangnan's Green Standard Army was the same, except that the Xuzhou garrison standard was slowly withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's Green Standard Army was the same, except that the Xuzhou garrison standard was slowly withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 山東以全裁綠營情事窒礙，因請緩裁。

translations.literal: Shandong, because complete abolition of the Green Standard Army encountered obstacles, therefore requested deferred cuts.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong, finding that complete abolition of the Green Standard Army encountered obstacles, requested deferred cuts.

sentences.zh: 廣東綠營，三江、崖州二協，儋州營，督標中營均免裁。

translations.literal: For Guangdong's Green Standard Army, the two brigades of Sanjiang and Yazhou, the Danzhou Camp, and the governor-general's central battalion were all exempted from cuts.
translations.idiomatic: For Guangdong's Green Standard Army, the two brigades at Sanjiang and Yazhou, the Danzhou Camp, and the governor-general's central battalion were all exempted from cuts.

sentences.zh: 其餘十減其四，將領五百餘，除邊要及兼防營之缺緩裁，餘悉停補，改練陸軍。

translations.literal: Of the remainder, four-tenths were cut, leaving over five hundred officers; except vacancies at frontier vital points and concurrently defending camps, which were to be cut slowly, all other vacancies had replacements halted and were reorganized into the modern Army.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder was reduced by four-tenths, leaving over five hundred officers. Vacancies at frontier vital points and concurrently defending camps were to be cut slowly; all others had replacements halted as the force was reorganized into the modern Army.

sentences.zh: 廣西綠營，自光緒二十九年裁後，僅存撫、提標將領五或四人，兵四五十人，左江、右江兩鎮將領各二人，兵各二十人。

translations.literal: Guangxi's Green Standard Army, after cuts in the twenty-ninth year of Guangxu, retained only four or five officers under the governor's and provincial commander's standards and forty or fifty soldiers; at the Left River and Right River garrisons each had two officers and twenty soldiers each.
translations.idiomatic: After the Guangxu 29 (1903) cuts, Guangxi's Green Standard Army retained only four or five officers under the governor's and provincial commander's standards and forty or fifty soldiers. The Left River and Right River garrisons each had two officers and twenty soldiers apiece.

sentences.zh: 此歷朝裁兵大較也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of troop reductions through the dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the general picture of troop reductions through the dynasties.

sentences.zh: 綠營積重，沿數百年。

translations.literal: The Green Standard system had accumulated weight over several centuries.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard system had grown ponderous over several centuries.

sentences.zh: 同治中興以後，疆臣列帥，懲前毖後，漸改練勇巡防之制。

translations.literal: After the Tongzhi restoration, frontier governors and commanders in succession, taking warning from the past, gradually changed to the drilled brave corps and patrol defense system.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tongzhi restoration, frontier governors and commanders, learning from past failures, gradually shifted to the drilled brave corps and patrol defense system.

sentences.zh: 光、宣間屢加裁汰。

translations.literal: During the Guangxu and Xuantong reigns, repeated cuts and eliminations were applied.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu and Xuantong reigns, repeated rounds of cuts and eliminations were applied.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，武昌事起，陸軍部疏言時局艱危，各省綠營、巡防隊一律從緩裁撤。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, when the incident at Wuchang erupted, the Ministry of the Army memorialized that the times were perilous, and the Green Standard Army and patrol defense corps of all provinces were uniformly to have abolition deferred.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 (1911), when the Wuchang uprising broke out, the Ministry of the Army memorialized that the times were perilous and directed that the Green Standard Army and patrol defense corps of all provinces uniformly defer abolition.

sentences.zh: 綠營之制，遂與有清相終始雲。

translations.literal: Thus the Green Standard system endured from beginning to end with the Qing dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Green Standard system endured from the founding to the fall of the Qing dynasty.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督統轄督標四營，節制一提督、七總兵，兼轄保定城守，熱河喀喇沁，吉林、奉天捕盜，永定河、運河等營。

translations.literal: The Zhili governor-general commanded four battalions under the governor-general's standard, exercised operational control over one provincial commander and seven regional commanders, and also had jurisdiction over the Baoding city garrison, Rehe Kharchin, Jilin and Fengtian anti-bandit camps, and the Yongding River, Grand Canal, and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhili governor-general had direct command of four battalions under the governor-general's standard, exercised operational control over one provincial commander and seven regional commanders, and also held jurisdiction over the Baoding city garrison, Rehe Kharchin, Jilin and Fengtian anti-bandit camps, and the Yongding River, Grand Canal, and other camps.

sentences.zh: 直隸古北口提督統轄提標四營，節制七鎮，兼轄河屯一協、三屯等營。

translations.literal: The Zhili Gubeikou provincial commander commanded four battalions under the provincial commander's standard, exercised operational control over seven garrisons, and also had jurisdiction over one Hetun brigade, Santun, and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhili Gubeikou provincial commander had direct command of four battalions under the provincial commander's standard, exercised operational control over seven garrisons, and also held jurisdiction over the Hetun brigade, Santun, and other camps.

sentences.zh: 提標中營、左營、右營、前營，密雲城守營，順義營，承德府河屯協左營、右營，唐三營，三屯營，喜峰路，燕河路，建昌路，八溝營，建昌營，赤峰營，朝陽營，昌平營，居庸路，鞏華營，懷柔路，湯泉營，古北口。

translations.literal: Center, left, right, and front battalions under the provincial commander's standard; Miyun city garrison camp; Shunyi camp; left and right battalions of the Chengde Prefecture Hetun brigade; Tang's three camps; Santun camp; Xifeng Route; Yanhe Route; Jianchang Route; Bagou camp; Jianchang camp; Chifeng camp; Chaoyang camp; Changping camp; Juyong Route; Gonghua camp; Huairou Route; Tangquan camp; Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: These included the center, left, right, and front battalions under the provincial commander's standard; the Miyun city garrison camp; the Shunyi camp; the left and right battalions of the Chengde Prefecture Hetun brigade; Tang's three camps; the Santun camp; Xifeng, Yanhe, and Jianchang Routes; the Bagou, Jianchang, Chifeng, Chaoyang, and Changping camps; Juyong Route; the Gonghua camp; Huairou Route; the Tangquan camp; and Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 馬蘭鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄遵化等營。

translations.literal: The Malan Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over Zunhua and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Malan Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over Zunhua and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，遵化營，薊州營，曹家路，牆子路，黃花山，餘丁營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Zunhua camp; Jizhou camp; Caojia Route; Qiangzi Route; Huanghuashan; Yuding camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Zunhua and Jizhou camps; Caojia and Qiangzi Routes; Huanghuashan; and the Yuding camp.

sentences.zh: 泰寧鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄紫荊關等營。

translations.literal: The Taining Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over Zijing Pass and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Taining Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over Zijing Pass and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，水東★營，紫荊關，白石口營，廣昌營，插箭嶺，礬山營，易州營，房山營，淶水營，馬水口，沿河口。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Shuidong ★ camp; Zijing Pass; Baishikou camp; Guangchang camp; Chajianling; Fanshan camp; Yizhou camp; Fangshan camp; Laishui camp; Mashuikou; Yanhekou.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Shuidong ★ camp; Zijing Pass; the Baishikou, Guangchang, and Fanshan camps; Chajianling; the Yizhou, Fangshan, and Laishui camps; Mashuikou; and Yanhekou.

sentences.zh: 宣化鎮總兵統轄鎮標三營，兼轄獨石口、多倫諾爾二協，蔚州等營。

translations.literal: The Xuanhua Garrison regional commander commanded three battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over the Dushikou and Duolun'or brigades and Wuzhou and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanhua Garrison regional commander had direct command of three battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over the Dushikou and Duolun'or brigades and Wuzhou and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標中營、左營、右營，獨石口協左營、右營，鎮安營，龍門所營，雲州堡，馬雲堡，鎮寧堡，松樹堡，滴水堡，赤城堡，君子堡，靖安堡，多倫諾爾協中營、左營、右營，蔚州營，東城營，宣化城守營，懷來營，懷來城守營，岔道營，龍門路營，懷安營，左衛營，柴溝營，西陽河堡營，張家口營，萬全營，膳房堡營，新河口堡營，洗馬林堡營。

translations.literal: Center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; left and right battalions of the Dushikou brigade; Zhen'an camp; Longmensuo camp; Yunzhou Fort; Mayun Fort; Zhenning Fort; Songshu Fort; Dishui Fort; Chicheng Fort; Junzi Fort; Jing'an Fort; center, left, and right battalions of the Duolun'or brigade; Wuzhou camp; Dongcheng camp; Xuanhua city garrison camp; Huailai camp; Huailai city garrison camp; Chadao camp; Longmen Route camp; Huai'an camp; Zuowei camp; Chaigou camp; Xiyanghe Fort camp; Zhangjiakou camp; Wanquan camp; Shanfang Fort camp; Xinhekou Fort camp; Ximalin Fort camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; the left and right battalions of the Dushikou brigade; the Zhen'an, Longmensuo, and Wuzhou camps; the Dongcheng camp; the Xuanhua city garrison camp; the Huailai and Huailai city garrison camps; the Chadao and Longmen Route camps; the Huai'an, Zuowei, and Chaigou camps; the Xiyanghe Fort, Zhangjiakou, and Wanquan camps; and the Shanfang Fort, Xinhekou Fort, and Ximalin Fort camps, along with Yunzhou, Mayun, Zhenning, Songshu, Dishui, Chicheng, Junzi, and Jing'an Forts and the center, left, and right battalions of the Duolun'or brigade.

sentences.zh: 天津鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄河間、大沽二協，務關等營。

translations.literal: The Tianjin Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over the Hejian and Dagu brigades and Wuguan and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over the Hejian and Dagu brigades and Wuguan and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，四黨口營，河間協左營、右營，鄭家口營，景州營，大沽協前左及中左、後左、前右、中右、後右六營，葛沽營，祁口營，務關營，霸州營，武清營，靜海營，舊州營，天津城守營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Sidangkou camp; left and right battalions of the Hejian brigade; Zhengjiakou camp; Jingzhou camp; six battalions of the Dagu brigade—front left, center left, rear left, front right, center right, and rear right; Ge'gu camp; Qikou camp; Wuguan camp; Bazhou camp; Wuqing camp; Jinghai camp; Jiuzhou camp; Tianjin city garrison camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Sidangkou camp; the left and right battalions of the Hejian brigade; the Zhengjiakou and Jingzhou camps; the six battalions of the Dagu brigade—front left, center left, rear left, front right, center right, and rear right; the Ge'gu, Qikou, Wuguan, Bazhou, Wuqing, Jinghai, and Jiuzhou camps; and the Tianjin city garrison camp.

sentences.zh: 正定鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄固關等營。

translations.literal: The Zhending Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over Guguan and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhending Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over Guguan and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，固關營，龍泉關營，倒馬關營，忠順關營，龍固城守營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Guguan camp; Longquan Pass camp; Daoma Pass camp; Zhongshun Pass camp; Longgu city garrison camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Guguan, Longquan Pass, Daoma Pass, and Zhongshun Pass camps; and the Longgu city garrison camp.

sentences.zh: 大名鎮總兵統轄鎮標三營，兼轄開州協、大名城守等營。

translations.literal: The Daming Garrison regional commander commanded three battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over the Kaizhou brigade, the Daming city garrison, and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Daming Garrison regional commander had direct command of three battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over the Kaizhou brigade, the Daming city garrison, and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標中營、左營、右營，開州協，杜勝營，東明營，長垣營，大名城守營，廣平營，順德營，磁州營。

translations.literal: Center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; Kaizhou brigade; Dusheng camp; Dongming camp; Changyuan camp; Daming city garrison camp; Guangping camp; Shunde camp; Cizhou camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Kaizhou brigade; the Dusheng, Dongming, Changyuan, and Daming city garrison camps; and the Guangping, Shunde, and Cizhou camps.

sentences.zh: 通永鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄通州、山永二協，北塘等四營。

translations.literal: The Tongyong Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over the Tongzhou and Shanyong brigades and four camps including Beitang.
translations.idiomatic: The Tongyong Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over the Tongzhou and Shanyong brigades and four camps including Beitang.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，通州協左營、右營，張家灣營，采育營，三河營，山永協左營、右營，山海路營，石門路營，蒲河營，樂亭營，北塘營，豐順營，玉田營，寶坻營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; left and right battalions of the Tongzhou brigade; Zhangjiawan camp; Caiyu camp; Sanhe camp; left and right battalions of the Shanyong brigade; Shanhai Route camp; Shimen Route camp; Puhe camp; Leting camp; Beitang camp; Fengshun camp; Yutian camp; Baodi camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the left and right battalions of the Tongzhou and Shanyong brigades; the Zhangjiawan, Caiyu, Sanhe, Shanhai Route, Shimen Route, Puhe, Leting, Beitang, Fengshun, Yutian, and Baodi camps.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫兼提督，駐濟南府，節制三鎮，統轄撫標二營，兼轄登榮水師一協。

translations.literal: The Shandong governor, who also held the title of provincial commander, was stationed at Jinan Prefecture, exercised operational control over three garrisons, commanded two battalions under the governor's standard, and also had jurisdiction over one Deng-Rong naval forces brigade.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong governor, who also held the title of provincial commander, was stationed at Jinan Prefecture. He exercised operational control over three garrisons, had direct command of two battalions under the governor's standard, and also held jurisdiction over one Deng-Rong naval forces brigade.

sentences.zh: 撫標左營、右營，登榮水師練軍營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the governor's standard; Deng-Rong naval forces drilled troops camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the governor's standard and the Deng-Rong naval forces drilled troops camp.

sentences.zh: 兗州鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄沂州一協、泰安等六營。

translations.literal: The Yanzhou Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over one Yizhou brigade and six camps including Tai'an.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanzhou Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over the Yizhou brigade and six camps including Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，沂州協，泰安營，台庄營，濟南城守營，武定營，安東營，沙溝營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Yizhou brigade; Tai'an camp; Taizhuang camp; Jinan city garrison camp; Wuding camp; Andong camp; Shagou camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Yizhou brigade; and the Tai'an, Taizhuang, Jinan city garrison, Wuding, Andong, and Shagou camps.

sentences.zh: 登州鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄文登等七營。

translations.literal: The Dengzhou Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over seven camps including Wendeng.
translations.idiomatic: The Dengzhou Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over seven camps including Wendeng.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，文登營，膠州協，萊州營，即墨營，青州營，寧福營，壽樂營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Wendeng camp; Jiaozhou brigade; Laizhou camp; Jimo camp; Qingzhou camp; Ningfu camp; Shoule camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard; the Wendeng, Laizhou, Jimo, Qingzhou, Ningfu, and Shoule camps; and the Jiaozhou brigade.

sentences.zh: 曹州鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄臨清協、德州等營。

sentences.zh: 鎮標中營、左營、右營，上江協左營、右營，都勻協左營、右營，朗洞營左營、右營，黎平營左營、右營，荔波營，下江營。

translations.literal: Center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; left and right battalions of the Shangjiang brigade; left and right battalions of the Duyun brigade; left and right battalions of the Langdong camp; left and right battalions of the Liping camp; Libo camp; Xiajiang camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; the left and right battalions of the Shangjiang and Duyun brigades; the left and right battalions of the Langdong and Liping camps; and the Libo and Xiajiang camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮遠鎮總兵統轄鎮標三營，兼轄清江等三協、台拱等營。

translations.literal: The Zhenyuan Garrison regional commander commanded three battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over the three brigades including Qingjiang and the Taigong and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenyuan Garrison regional commander had direct command of three battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over three brigades including Qingjiang and the Taigong and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標中營、左營、右營，清江協左營、右營，松桃協左營、右營，銅仁協左營、右營，台拱營左營、右營，丹江營左營、右營，思南營，凱里營，黃平營，天柱營，石阡營。

translations.literal: Center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; left and right battalions of the Qingjiang brigade; left and right battalions of the Songtao brigade; left and right battalions of the Tongren brigade; left and right battalions of the Taigong camp; left and right battalions of the Danjiang camp; Sinan camp; Kaili camp; Huangping camp; Tianzhu camp; Shiqian camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the center, left, and right battalions under the garrison standard; the left and right battalions of the Qingjiang, Songtao, and Tongren brigades; the left and right battalions of the Taigong and Danjiang camps; and the Sinan, Kaili, Huangping, Tianzhu, and Shiqian camps.

sentences.zh: 威寧鎮總兵統轄鎮標二營，兼轄畢赤、水城等營。

translations.literal: The Weining Garrison regional commander commanded two battalions under the garrison standard and also had jurisdiction over the Bichi, Shuicheng, and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Weining Garrison regional commander had direct command of two battalions under the garrison standard and also held jurisdiction over the Bichi, Shuicheng, and other camps.

sentences.zh: 鎮標左營、右營，畢赤營，水城營。

translations.literal: Left and right battalions under the garrison standard; Bichi camp; Shuicheng camp.
translations.idiomatic: These included the left and right battalions under the garrison standard and the Bichi and Shuicheng camps.

sentences.zh: 綠營兵額，清初未定。

translations.literal: Green Standard Army troop quotas were not fixed in the early Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard Army troop quotas were not fixed in the early Qing period.

sentences.zh: 考明代京軍二十萬餘，外軍九十九萬餘。

translations.literal: Examining the Ming dynasty, the capital army numbered over 200,000 and the exterior army over 990,000.
translations.idiomatic: By Ming dynasty figures, the capital army numbered over 200,000 and the provincial armies over 990,000.

sentences.zh: 順治間不可考，大約視舊額約裁減十三四。

translations.literal: The Shunzhi period cannot be verified; roughly speaking, compared with the old quotas, cuts amounted to about three or four parts in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Figures for the Shunzhi period cannot be verified, but compared with the old quotas, cuts appear to have amounted to roughly thirty or forty percent.

sentences.zh: 康熙兵制，京巡捕三營經制馬步兵三千三百，直隸各標兵三萬七百，山西二萬五千，川陝總督，陝、甘兩巡撫及提鎮各標兵八萬五千九百七十八，四川四萬，雲南四萬二千，貴州二萬，廣西二萬，湖廣四萬，廣東七萬三千一百十人，江南總督，總漕，江寧、安徽兩巡撫，京口將軍四萬九千八百五十，浙江四萬三千四百五十，江西萬五千，福建六萬九千七百二十六，山東總河及撫、鎮標兵二萬，河南一萬，都各省經制馬步兵五十九萬四千四百十四。

translations.literal: Under the Kangxi military system: the capital patrol three camps had 3,300 established cavalry and infantry; Zhili's various garrison standards 30,700; Shanxi 25,000; the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, the Shaanxi and Gansu governors, and the provincial and garrison commanders' various standards 85,978; Sichuan 40,000; Yunnan 42,000; Guizhou 20,000; Guangxi 20,000; Huguang 40,000; Guangdong 73,110 men; the Jiangnan governor-general, the Grand Canal intendant, the Jiangning and Anhui governors, and the Jingkou General 49,850; Zhejiang 43,450; Jiangxi 15,000; Fujian 69,726; the Shandong Grand Canal intendant and governor and garrison standards 20,000; Henan 10,000; in all the provinces' established cavalry and infantry totaled 594,414.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Kangxi military system, the capital's three patrol camps fielded 3,300 established cavalry and infantry; Zhili's garrison standards 30,700; Shanxi 25,000; the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, the Shaanxi and Gansu governors, and their provincial and garrison commanders' standards 85,978; Sichuan 40,000; Yunnan 42,000; Guizhou 20,000; Guangxi 20,000; Huguang 40,000; Guangdong 73,110; the Jiangnan governor-general, Grand Canal intendant, Jiangning and Anhui governors, and Jingkou General 49,850; Zhejiang 43,450; Jiangxi 15,000; Fujian 69,726; Shandong's Grand Canal intendant and governor and garrison standards 20,000; Henan 10,000; and all provinces together 594,414 established cavalry and infantry.

sentences.zh: 逮乾隆二十九年，次第增加，各省多者一千至六千餘，惟貴州加至萬八千二百餘，減者江西七百餘，廣東四百餘，浙江二千餘，福建三千餘，都六十三萬七千三百二十三。

translations.literal: By the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong, increases followed in sequence: most provinces gained from 1,000 to over 6,000, but Guizhou increased by over 18,200; reductions were Jiangxi over 700, Guangdong over 400, Zhejiang over 2,000, and Fujian over 3,000; in all 637,323.
translations.idiomatic: By Qianlong 29 (1764), increases were made in stages: most provinces gained between 1,000 and 6,000-odd men, while Guizhou alone gained over 18,200; Jiangxi lost over 700, Guangdong over 400, Zhejiang over 2,000, and Fujian over 3,000; the empire-wide total reached 637,323.

sentences.zh: 至五十年，各省綠營兵額，京巡捕五營一萬，直隸三萬九千四百二，山東萬七千五百四，山西二萬五千七百五十二，河南萬一千八百七十四，江南四萬八千七百四十七，江西萬三千九百二十九，福建六萬三千一百十九，浙江四萬三十七，湖北萬七千七百九十四，湖南二萬三千六百四，四川三萬千一百十二，陝、甘八萬四千四百九十六，廣東六萬八千九十四，廣西二萬三千五百八十八，雲南四萬千三百五十三，貴州三萬七千七百六十九，都五十九萬九千八百十四，綜計數減於舊者凡四萬餘。

translations.literal: By the fiftieth year, Green Standard Army quotas in each province were: capital patrol five camps 10,000; Zhili 39,402; Shandong 17,504; Shanxi 25,752; Henan 11,874; Jiangnan 48,747; Jiangxi 13,929; Fujian 63,119; Zhejiang 40,037; Hubei 17,794; Hunan 23,604; Sichuan 31,112; Shaanxi-Gansu 84,496; Guangdong 68,094; Guangxi 23,588; Yunnan 41,353; Guizhou 37,769; in all 599,814; taken together the total was over 40,000 below the old figure.
translations.idiomatic: By the fiftieth year, provincial Green Standard quotas stood at: capital patrol five camps, 10,000; Zhili 39,402; Shandong 17,504; Shanxi 25,752; Henan 11,874; Jiangnan 48,747; Jiangxi 13,929; Fujian 63,119; Zhejiang 40,037; Hubei 17,794; Hunan 23,604; Sichuan 31,112; Shaanxi-Gansu 84,496; Guangdong 68,094; Guangxi 23,588; Yunnan 41,353; Guizhou 37,769; totaling 599,814 empire-wide—a net reduction of over 40,000 from the earlier figure.

sentences.zh: 各省減者，自數百至數千不等，惟陝、甘減至萬二千，則以四十六年新增者不在此數，而山東、河南、江南視舊額轉多，蓋河、漕標兵本定分額，此實併入各省中也。

translations.literal: Provincial reductions ranged from several hundred to several thousand, but Shaanxi-Gansu was reduced by 12,000 because the additions of the forty-sixth year are not counted here; Shandong, Henan, and Jiangnan, by contrast, exceeded the old quotas, for the river and canal garrison standards had originally been fixed as separate quotas and were in fact merged into the provincial totals.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial reductions ranged from several hundred to several thousand men, but Shaanxi-Gansu alone was cut by 12,000—the additions made in the forty-sixth year not being counted here. Shandong, Henan, and Jiangnan, by contrast, exceeded their old quotas, because the river and canal garrison standards had originally been fixed as separate establishments and were in fact merged into the provincial totals.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十七年，綠營都數為六十六萬千六百七十一，視乾隆中葉增額六萬餘，各省均所有益，惟浙江減額千餘。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiaqing, the Green Standard Army total was 661,671, an increase of over 60,000 compared with mid-Qianlong quotas; every province gained except Zhejiang, which lost over 1,000.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 17 (1812), the Green Standard Army totaled 661,671—over 60,000 more than the mid-Qianlong establishment. Every province gained except Zhejiang, which lost over 1,000 men.

sentences.zh: 其江南總額，此分江寧七千三十九，南河萬五千六百六十六，漕運三千六百八十一，江蘇二萬三千七百四十八，安徽八千七百三十八，總為五萬六千八百七十二，增舊額八千餘。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan total was here divided into Jiangning 7,039, Southern Canal 15,666, Canal transport 3,681, Jiangsu 23,748, and Anhui 8,738, totaling 56,872—an increase of over 8,000 over the old quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan total was here broken down as Jiangning 7,039, Southern Canal 15,666, canal transport 3,681, Jiangsu 23,748, and Anhui 8,738, totaling 56,872—over 8,000 above the old quota.

sentences.zh: 又舊額但舉山東，此分山東萬五千九百三十三，東河四千二百四十一，增額三千餘，略可考見。

translations.literal: Moreover, the old quota cited only Shandong; here Shandong was divided into Shandong 15,933 and Eastern Canal 4,241, an increase of over 3,000, which can be roughly verified.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the old quota cited only Shandong as a whole; here it was divided into Shandong proper at 15,933 and the Eastern Canal at 4,241, an increase of over 3,000 that can be roughly verified.

sentences.zh: 十九年，山西等省共裁兵萬五千四百餘，內改馬戰兵為步守兵共千二百餘。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Shanxi and other provinces together cut over 15,400 troops, of whom over 1,200 mounted combat soldiers were converted to infantry garrison soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, Shanxi and other provinces together cut over 15,400 troops, converting over 1,200 mounted combat soldiers to infantry garrison soldiers in the process.

sentences.zh: 道光初元，諭行裁汰，減額萬餘，復議裁改。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daoguang, an edict ordered cuts to be carried out, reducing quotas by over 10,000; further cuts and conversions were then debated.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Daoguang reign, an edict ordered troop reductions, cutting over 10,000 from the quotas; further cuts and conversions were then debated.

sentences.zh: 二十九年兵額，直隸四萬千三百三十五，山東二萬五十七，河南萬五千三百八十一，東河併入河南、山東。

translations.literal: Troop quotas in the twenty-ninth year: Zhili 41,335; Shandong 20,057; Henan 15,381; the Eastern Canal was merged into Henan and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Troop quotas in the twenty-ninth year stood at Zhili 41,335, Shandong 20,057, and Henan 15,381, with the Eastern Canal establishment merged into Henan and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 山西二萬二千八百五，江蘇三萬八千一百八，安徽九千四百四十二，南河、漕運併入江南。

translations.literal: Shanxi 22,805; Jiangsu 38,108; Anhui 9,442; the Southern Canal and canal transport were merged into Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi had 22,805; Jiangsu 38,108; Anhui 9,442; and the Southern Canal and canal transport establishments were merged into Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 江西萬二千四百七十二，福建六萬千六百七十五，浙江三萬七千五百六十五，陝西二萬四千七百二十，甘肅六萬八千八百六十二，湖北二萬五百五，湖南二萬七千百十五，四川三萬三千八百十一，廣東六萬八千三百二十二，廣西二萬二千四百七十二，雲南三萬九千七百六十二，貴州三萬六千四百七十七，都五十八萬五千四百十二，京營萬名在外。

translations.literal: Jiangxi 12,472; Fujian 61,675; Zhejiang 37,565; Shaanxi 24,720; Gansu 68,862; Hubei 20,505; Hunan 27,115; Sichuan 33,811; Guangdong 68,322; Guangxi 22,472; Yunnan 39,762; Guizhou 36,477; in all 585,412, not counting the 10,000 in the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi had 12,472; Fujian 61,675; Zhejiang 37,565; Shaanxi 24,720; Gansu 68,862; Hubei 20,505; Hunan 27,115; Sichuan 33,811; Guangdong 68,322; Guangxi 22,472; Yunnan 39,762; and Guizhou 36,477, totaling 585,412 empire-wide, not counting the 10,000 in the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 減於乾隆舊額且逾萬矣。

translations.literal: The reduction from the Qianlong old quota exceeded 10,000.
translations.idiomatic: This was a reduction of more than 10,000 from the Qianlong-era establishment.

sentences.zh: 咸豐軍興以來，綠營議裁。

translations.literal: Since military operations began in the Xianfeng period, cuts to the Green Standard Army have been debated.
translations.idiomatic: Since the outbreak of warfare in the Xianfeng period, cuts to the Green Standard Army have been under discussion.

sentences.zh: 迄同治、光緒間，兵制一變，直省厲行簡汰，顧不能悉廢，存額尚不為少。

translations.literal: By the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods the military system had changed entirely; the provinces rigorously simplified and cut forces, yet could not abolish them altogether, and the remaining quotas were still not small.
translations.idiomatic: By the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods the military system had changed entirely. The provinces rigorously simplified and cut forces, yet could not abolish them altogether, and the remaining authorized strength was still considerable.

sentences.zh: 再綜近時綠營兵額，京巡捕營一萬外，十六門門甲三百十，門軍六百四十，凡萬九百五十，直隸四萬二千八百十，山東萬七千八百七十五，山西萬六千四十五，河南萬四百六十八，江蘇二萬五千七百七十，安徽九千三百六十四，江西萬一千七百四十，長江水師萬一千六十四，福建二萬三千六百七十八，台灣八千二百六十八，浙江二萬三千四百九，湖北萬五千三百四十三，湖南三萬零二十四，陝西萬八千六百八十七，甘肅萬二千七百二十五，新疆二萬六千五百十五，四川三萬千二百八十一，廣東四萬六千七百七十四，廣西萬四千一百十五，雲南萬二千五百七十二，貴州四萬二千九百五，都四十六萬二千三百八十二。

translations.literal: A further summary of recent Green Standard Army quotas: apart from the 10,000 in the capital patrol camps, the Sixteen Gates had 310 gate guards and 640 gate soldiers, totaling 10,950; Zhili 42,810; Shandong 17,875; Shanxi 16,045; Henan 10,468; Jiangsu 25,770; Anhui 9,364; Jiangxi 11,740; Yangtze naval forces 11,064; Fujian 23,678; Taiwan 8,268; Zhejiang 23,409; Hubei 15,343; Hunan 30,024; Shaanxi 18,687; Gansu 12,725; Xinjiang 26,515; Sichuan 31,281; Guangdong 46,774; Guangxi 14,115; Yunnan 12,572; Guizhou 42,905; in all 462,382.
translations.idiomatic: A further summary of recent Green Standard quotas shows that, apart from the 10,000 in the capital patrol camps, the Sixteen Gates fielded 310 gate guards and 640 gate soldiers, totaling 10,950; Zhili had 42,810; Shandong 17,875; Shanxi 16,045; Henan 10,468; Jiangsu 25,770; Anhui 9,364; Jiangxi 11,740; Yangtze naval forces 11,064; Fujian 23,678; Taiwan 8,268; Zhejiang 23,409; Hubei 15,343; Hunan 30,024; Shaanxi 18,687; Gansu 12,725; Xinjiang 26,515; Sichuan 31,281; Guangdong 46,774; Guangxi 14,115; Yunnan 12,572; and Guizhou 42,905, totaling 462,382 empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 取道光末年額較之，減於舊者幾十二萬，但舊額不及長江水師與台灣雲。

translations.literal: Compared with the quotas at the end of Daoguang, the reduction from the old figure was nearly 120,000, but the old quotas did not include the Yangtze naval forces, Taiwan, and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the end-of-Daoguang quotas, the reduction came to nearly 120,000 men, though the old quotas had not included the Yangtze naval forces, Taiwan, or Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 督標四營。

translations.literal: Four battalions under the governor-general's standard.
translations.idiomatic: There were four battalions under the governor-general's standard.

sentences.zh: 左營，右營，前營，後營。

translations.literal: Left battalion, right battalion, front battalion, rear battalion.
translations.idiomatic: These were the left, right, front, and rear battalions.

sentences.zh: 保定城守等營。

translations.literal: Baoding city garrison and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: These included the Baoding city garrison and other camps.

translations.idiomatic: These included the Xinxiong, Zhuozhou, Gongji, and Liangxiang camps; the Central, Eastern, Southern, Western, and Northern routes; and Zhangjiakou and Dushikou.

sentences.zh: 熱河喀喇沁等營。

translations.literal: Rehe Kharachin and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: These included the Rehe Kharachin and other camps.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭哈達，塔子溝，承德府，平泉州，三座塔，多倫諾爾廳。

translations.idiomatic: These included Ulanhada, Tazigou, Chengde prefecture, Pingzhou prefecture, Sanzuota, and Dolon Nor department.

sentences.zh: 吉林捕盜營。

translations.literal: Jilin bandit-suppression camp.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Jilin bandit-suppression camp.

translations.literal: Binzhou department, Wuchang department, Dunhua county, Shuangcheng department, Yitong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: These included Binzhou department, Wuchang department, Dunhua county, Shuangcheng department, and Yitong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 奉天捕盜營。

translations.literal: Fengtian bandit-suppression camp.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Fengtian bandit-suppression camp.

translations.idiomatic: These included Changtu prefecture, Xinmin department, Haicheng department, Chengde county, Kaiyuan county, Tieling, Liaoyang prefecture, Jin county, Ningyuan prefecture, Yizhou, Guangning county, Gaiping county, Fuzhou, Jinzhou department, Huaide county, Fenghua county, Tangping county, Hailong department, Fenghuang department, Andong county, Kuandian county, Huairen county, Tonghua county, Xingjing, and Xiuyan prefecture.

translations.literal: Yongding River, Grand Canal, and other camps.
translations.idiomatic: These included the Yongding River, Grand Canal, and other camps.

translations.idiomatic: These included the Northern Grand Canal service customs department, Yangcun department, Tonghui River canal transport department, and Southern Grand Canal.
